cards.name: Disappearance at the Twilight Estate
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -3. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-3。如果你失敗且本次檢定為攻擊或躲避嘗試，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -5. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-5。如果你失敗且本次檢定為攻擊或躲避嘗試，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: JUDGEMENT • XX
cards.text: Forced - After doom is placed on any card: Each investigator must either take 1 damage or 1 horror (2 damage or 2 horror instead if there is 5 or more doom in play). Forced - When any investigator is defeated, that investigator must advance this agenda. Do not remove any doom from this agenda when it advances.
cards.text_cn: 強制- 在任何卡牌上放置了毀滅標記後：每位調查員必須受到1點傷害或1點恐懼(如果場上有至少5個毀滅標記，改為受到2點傷害或2點恐懼)。 強制 - 在任何一位調查員被擊敗時，該調查員必須推進本密謀。本密謀推進時，不要移除其上任何毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: In the "Missing Persons" section of your Campaign Log, next to your character's profile, make a record of that character's fate, as follows. Then flip this agenda back over. - If you were defeated by The Spectral Watcher's attack, record (character's name) was taken by the Watcher. - If you were defeated by a [[Monster]] enemy's attack, record (character's name) was claimed by specters. - If there was 7 or more doom in play when this agenda advanced, and you were defeated by horror or damage dealt by the Forced ability on agenda 1a, record (character's name) disappeared into the mist. - If you were defeated by any other effect, record(character's name) was pulled into the spectral realm.
cards.back_text_cn: 按照以下指示，翻到你冒險日誌的"失蹤人口"區域，在你角色旁邊記錄該角色的命運。然後將本密謀翻至另一面。 - 如果你因幽靈看守人的攻擊而被擊敗，記錄下(角色姓名)被看守人抓走。 - 如果你因[[怪物]]敵人的攻擊而被擊敗，記錄下(角色姓名)已被幽靈奪走性命。 - 如果本密謀推進時場上有至少7個毀滅標記，且你因密謀la的強制能力造成的恐懼或傷害而被擊敗，記錄下(角色姓名)消失在迷霧之中。 - 如果你因其他任何效果而被擊敗，記錄下(角色姓名)被拉入幽靈國度。

cards.name: The Disappearance
cards.text: Forced - When an investigator is eliminated: Place each of that investigator's clues on this act instead of his or her location. Objective - Discover as many clues as you can before your inevitable demise.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在有調查員退場時：不將該調查員的所有線索放在其所在地點，改為放在本場景上。 目標 - 在你不可避免的末日來臨之前，發現盡可能多的線索。
cards.back_text: Record in your Campaign Log you are being hunted. Flip back to Act 1a.
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌中記錄你被追捕。 翻面至場景la。

cards.name: Gavriella Mizrah
cards.text:
[reaction] After an enemy attacks you, even if that attack was canceled: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.text_cn:
[reaction]在敵人攻擊你後(不論該次攻擊是否被取消)：發現你所在地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。治癒1點傷害和1點恐懼。
cards.back_text: Setup: You begin play in the Victorian Halls. Place 1 damage on The Spectral Watcher. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Fate of All Fools and put it into play in your threat area. You begin with 1 resource instead of 5. Starting Play Area: .45 Automatic (Core 16) with 2 ammo tokens remaining, Physical Training (Core 17). Opening Hand: First Aid (Core 19), Guard Dog (Core 21), Evidence! (Core 22), Dodge (Core 23), Extra Ammunition (level 1) (Core 26), 2 copies of Delay the Inevitable (TCU 21).
cards.back_text_cn: 冒險設置：你從維多利亞式宴會廳開始遊戲。在幽靈看守人上放置1點傷害，從先前找出的卡牌中找出1張愚人的命運，將其放置入場並放置到你的威脅區域。遊戲開始時你不獲得5資源，改為獲得1資源。 起始遊戲區域：帶有2個子彈標記的.45自動手槍(基礎16)、體能訓練(基礎17)。 起始手牌：急救(基礎19)、看門狗(基礎21)、證據！(基礎22)、閃躲(基礎23)、多餘的彈藥(等級1)(基礎26)、2張劫數延後(萬象無終21)。

cards.name: Jerome Davids
cards.text:
[reaction] When an investigator at your location draws a treachery from the encounter deck, discard cards from your hand with a total of at least 2 [intellect] icons: Cancel that card's revelation effect. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Discover 1 clue at your location.
cards.text_cn:
[reaction]在你所在地點的一位調查員從遭遇牌堆抽出一張詭計卡時，棄掉你總計至少帶有2個[intellect]圖標的手牌。取消該卡牌的顯現效果。(每輪限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。發現你所在地點的1個線索。
cards.back_text: Setup: You begin play in the Office. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Nether Mist and 1 copy of Obscuring Fog. Spawn the Nether Mist in the Office and attach Obscuring Fog to the Office. You begin with 3 resources instead of 5. Starting Play Area: Nothing. Opening Hand: Hyperawareness (Core 34), Mind over Matter (Core 36), Working a Hunch (Core 37), Barricade (Core 38), Deduction (Core 39), Magnifying Glass (level 1) (Core 40), Fingerprint Kit (TCU 24), Connect the Dots (TCU 25), 2 copies of Curiosity (TCU 26).
cards.back_text_cn: 冒險設置：你從辦公室開始遊戲。從先前找出的卡牌中找出1張冥府之霧和1張朦朧之霧。將冥府之霧生成在辦公室，將朦朧之霧疊加到辦公室。遊戲開始時你不獲得5資源，改為獲得3資源。 起始遊戲區域：無卡牌。 起始手牌：超感知(基礎34)、心勝於物(基礎36)、專業的直覺(基礎37)、屏障(基礎38)、推理(基礎39)、放大鏡(等級1)(基礎40)、指紋採集工具(萬象無終24)、串聯線索(萬象無終25)、2張好奇心(萬象無終26)。

cards.name: Valentino Rivas
cards.text:
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, spend 2 resources: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Gain 2 resources.
cards.text_cn:
[free]你執行技能檢定期間，花費2資源：本次檢定難度降低1點。(每輪限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。獲得2資源。
cards.back_text: Setup: You begin play in the Billiards Room. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Shadow Hound and 1 copy of Terror in the Night. Spawn the Shadow Hound engaged with you and put Terror in the Night into play next to the agenda deck. You begin with 10 resources instead of 5. Starting Play Area: Well Connected (TCU 28). Opening Hand: .41 Derringer (Core 47), Opportunist (Core 53), Sure Gamble (level 3) (Core 56), 2 copies of Money Talks (TCU 29), 2 copies of Cunning (TCU 30).
cards.back_text_cn: 冒險設置：你從檯球室開始遊戲。從先前找出的卡牌中找出1張暗影獵犬和1張恐怖夜色。暗影獵犬生成並與你交戰，將恐怖夜色放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁。遊戲開始時你不獲得5資源，改為獲得10資源。 起始遊戲區域：良好人脈(萬象無終28)。 起始手牌：.41短口手槍(基礎47)、機會主義者(基礎53)、老千手法(等級3)(基礎56)、2張金錢萬能(萬象無終29)、2張狡猾(萬象無終30)。

cards.name: Penny White
cards.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test during a revelation effect: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this is a skill test during a revelation effect, you may take an additional action during your next turn.
cards.text_cn:
[reaction]你在一個顯現效果期間的技能檢定成功後：發現你所在地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果這是一個顯現效果期間進行的技能檢定，你可以在你下個回合進行一個額外行動。
cards.back_text: Setup: You begin play at the Balcony. Search the gathered cards for 1 copy of Wraith and 1 copy of Whispers in the Dark. Spawn the Wraith engaged with you and put Whispers in the Dark into play next to the agenda deck. You begin with 2 resources instead of 5. Starting Play Area: Dig Deep (Core 77), Knife (Core 86), Flashlight (Core 87) with 2 supply tokens remaining. Opening Hand: Stray Cat (Core 76), Lucky! (Core 80), Knife (Core 86), Flashlight (Core 87), 2 copies of Act of Desperation (TCU 37), 2 copies of Able Bodied (TCU 38).
cards.back_text_cn: 冒險設置：你從露臺開始遊戲。從先前找出的卡牌中找出1張怨靈和1張黑暗中的低語。怨靈生成並與你交戰，將黑暗中的低語放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁。遊戲開始時你不獲得5資源，改為獲得2資源。 起始遊戲區域：深挖(基礎77)、刀子(基礎86)、帶有2個補給標記的手電筒(基礎87)。 起始手牌：野貓(基礎76)、運氣好！(基礎80)、刀子(基礎86)、手電筒(基礎87)、2張絕望之舉(萬象無終37)、2張體格強健(萬象無終38)。

cards.name: The Witching Hour
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -1. If you fail, after this test resolves, draw the bottommost treachery in the encounter discard pile.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose an exhausted or damaged [[Witch]] enemy at your location or at a connecting location. Ready that enemy and heal all damage from it.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1。你失敗且每低於難度1點，丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。
[tablet]：-1。如果你失敗，在本次檢定結算後，抽取遭遇棄牌堆最底下的一張詭計卡。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，選擇你所在地點或連接地點上的1個被消耗或已受傷的[[女巫]]敵人。準備該敵人並治癒該敵人的所有傷害。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck equal to this test's difficulty.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, after this test resolves, draw the bottommost treachery in the encounter discard pile.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, ready each [[Witch]] enemy at your location and at each connecting location. Heal all damage from each of those enemies.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2。從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，棄掉的張數等於本次檢定的難度。
[tablet]：-2。如果你失敗，在本次檢定結算後，抽取遭遇棄牌堆最底下的一張詭計卡。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你失敗，準備你所在地點和所有連接地點的所有[[女巫]]敵人。治癒這些敵人的所有傷害。

cards.name: TEMPERANCE • XIV
cards.back_text: Discard all but the last 5 cards from the encounter deck. The investigator with the most cards in his or her play area must draw the topmost [[Witch]] enemy in the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 從遭遇牌堆棄牌，棄至剩下5張卡牌。遊戲區域有最多卡牌的調查員必須抽取遭遇棄牌堆最頂上的一張[[女巫]]敵人。

cards.name: The Night Howls
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 doom on this agenda for each [[Witch]] enemy at the Witches' Circle.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當一輪結束時：女巫圓環每有一個[[女巫]]敵人，在本密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and must search the collection for a random basic [[Omen]] or [[Curse]] weakness and add it to his or her deck. Each investigator who cannot suffers 1 mental trauma instead.
cards.back_text_cn: 存活的所有調查員被擊敗，必須從收藏中找出一張隨機的基礎[[徵兆]]或[[詛咒]]弱點，然後將它加入自己的牌組。每位不能這麼做的調查員改為受到1點精神創傷。

cards.name: Lost in the Woods
cards.text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another. You cannot enter locations in front of other investigators. Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 你面前的地點均相互連接。你不能進入其他調查員面前的地點。 目標 - 當一輪結束時，調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Each investigator must randomly choose 1 of the set-aside Arkham Woods locations, put it into play in front of him or her, and immediately move to that location (cannot be canceled).
Each investigator spawns a set-aside Goat Spawn at his or her location (if there are 4 investigators in the game, the lead investigator spawns the set-aside Relentless Dark Young, and each other investigator spawns a set-aside Goat Spawn, instead). Each investigator then tests [willpower] or [agility] (3). Each investigator who succeeds exhausts that enemy and disengages from it.
Shuffle one of the set-aside copies of Daemonic Piping into the encounter deck. Place the other two copies in the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn:
每位調查員必須從放在一邊的阿卡姆密林地點裡隨機選擇1張，將其放置入場，放到自己面前，並且立即移動到該地點(不能取消)。
每位調查員將放在一邊的一個黑山羊眷族生成到自己所在地點(如果是4人遊戲，改為調查員隊長將放在一邊的一個堅韌的黑山羊幼崽生成，其他每位調查員將放在一邊的一個黑山羊眷族生成)。然後每位調查員檢定[willpower]或[agility](3)。檢定成功的每位調查員消耗與自己交戰的敵人並且解除交戰。
將放在一邊的1張魔鬼的笛聲洗入遭遇牌堆。將另外2張魔鬼的笛聲放入遭遇棄牌堆。

cards.name: Witch Hauntings
cards.text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another. You cannot enter locations in front of other investigators. Objective - If a single investigator spends the requisite number of clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: 你面前的地點均相互連接。你不能進入其他調查員面前的地點。 目標 - 如果有一位調查員花費所需數量的線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: For the remainder of the scenario, investigators may now enter locations in front of other investigators.
cards.back_text_cn: 在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，調查員可以進入其他調查員面前的地點。

cards.name: Paths into Twilight
cards.text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another.
cards.text_cn: 你面前的地點均相互連接。

cards.name: A Circle Unbroken
cards.text: Locations in front of you are connected to one another. Objective - If Anette Mason is defeated, advance. Objective - If there are no clues on the Witches' Circle, advance.
cards.text_cn: 你面前的地點均相互連接。 目標 - 如果安妮特·梅森被擊敗，推進場景。 目標 - 如果女巫圓環上沒有線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If you advanced by defeating Anette Mason:
"Stop!" the coven's leader yells in a commanding voice, grimacing from the wounds you've inflicted. You're not sure if she's speaking to you or to the hooded women surrounding you, but regardless, there is a sudden stillness in the clearing around the circle
(→R1)
If you advanced by discovering all of the clues in the Witches' Circle:
A loud crack echoes throughout the woods as you break the circle and reverse the witches' spell. "No! They have broken the ritual!" one of the witches screams as the spell's energy backfires. White-hot lightning strikes the center of the field, sending dirt and debris flying in every direction. You duck for cover.
(→R2)
cards.back_text_cn:
如果你通過擊敗安妮特·梅森推進場景：
"住手！"女巫集會的領導者以命令的語氣喝道，表情因為你造成的傷口而痛苦扭曲。你不確定她是喝止你還是喝止包圍你的那群兜帽女子，但無論如何，圓環四周突然陷入了寂靜。
(→結局1)
如果你通過發現女巫圓環的所有線索推進場景：
一陣巨大的爆裂聲響徹樹林，你打破了女巫圓環並且逆轉了女巫的巫術。"不！他們破壞了儀式！"一名遭到巫術力量反噬的女巫尖叫道。炙熱的白色閃電擊中了場地中央，塵土與殘骸向各個方向飛散。你在掩體後躲了起來。
(→結局2)

cards.name: Anette Mason
cards.text: Retaliate. Forced - After the enemy phase begins: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Spawn each [[Witch]] enemy discarded by this effect at Anette Mason's location. If no [[Witch]] enemies are discarded by this effect, ready her.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 強制 - 在敵軍階段開始後：丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的3張卡牌。將此效果丟棄的所有[[女巫]]敵人生成在安妮特·梅森所在的地點。如果此效果未丟棄[[女巫]]敵人，準備安妮特·梅森。

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text:
You cannot investigate this location while you have between 3 and 10 resources.
[fast]: Choose an investigator at a different Witch-Haunted Woods. Move up to 3 of your resources to that investigator's resource pool, or vice versa. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn:
你擁有3到10點資源時不能調查本地點。
[free]：選擇位於不同的女巫作祟之林的1位調查員。將你最多3點資源移動到該調查員的資源池；或者反過來將該調查員的最多3點資源移動到你的資源池。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text: Forced - After any number of clues are discovered from this location: Each investigator at this location loses an equal number of resources.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點發現任意數量的線索後：本地點上的每位調查員失去相等數量的資源。

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text:
You cannot investigate this location while you have between 3 and 5 cards in hand.
[fast]: You choose and discard 1 card from your hand, then an investigator at a different Witch-Haunted Woods draws 1 card, or vice versa. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn:
你擁有3到5張手牌時不能調查本地點。
[free]：你選擇並丟棄1張手牌，然後在不同的女巫作祟之林的一位調查員抽取1張卡；或者該調查員選擇並丟棄1張手牌，你抽取一張卡牌。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text: Forced - When the last clue is discovered from this location: Spawn the topmost enemy in the encounter discard pile at this location. (If there are no enemies in the encounter discard pile, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded, and spawn that enemy instead.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在發現本地點的最後一個線索時：將遭遇棄牌堆最頂上的一張敵人生成在本地點。(如果遭遇棄牌堆中沒有敵人，改為從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到一張敵人卡被丟棄，生成該敵人。)

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text: Investigators at other Witch-Haunted Woods locations can commit 1 card to each skill test performed at this location, and vice versa.
cards.text_cn: 位於其他女巫作祟之林地點的每位調查員可以對本地點執行的每次技能檢定投入1張卡牌；或者反過來，本地點的調查員可以對其他女巫作祟之林的每次技能檢定投入1張卡牌。

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text: Forced - After any number of clues are discovered from this location: Each investigator at this location must discard an equal number of cards at random from his or her hand.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點發現任意數量的線索後：本地點的每位調查員必須隨機丟棄相等數量的手牌。

cards.name: Witch-Haunted Woods
cards.text: [reaction] When an enemy would spawn at a different Witch-Haunted Woods: Spawn it at this location instead. Then, it makes an immediate attack against each investigator at this location.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在一個敵人將要生成在不同的女巫作祟之林時：改為將其生成在本地點。然後，該敵人立即對本地點的每位調查員進行攻擊。

cards.name: At Death's Doorstep
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if your location is haunted).
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
[elder_thing]: -2. If there is a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你所在地點鬧鬼，改為-3)。
[tablet]：-2。如果你失敗且本次檢定為攻擊或躲避嘗試，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你所在地點有[[幽靈]]敵人，受到1點傷害。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if your location is haunted).
[tablet]: -3. If this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
[elder_thing]: -4. If there is a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果你所在地點鬧鬼，改為-4)。
[tablet]：-3。如果本次檢定為攻擊或躲避嘗試，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你所在地點有[[幽靈]]敵人，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。

cards.name: JUSTICE • XI
cards.text: [[Silver Twilight]] enemies cannot be damaged or defeated. Forced - When you draw a [[Monster]] enemy: Instead of spawning it, set it aside, out of play, and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect can cause this agenda to advance.
cards.text_cn: [[銀暮秘社]]敵人不能被傷害也不能被擊敗。 強制 - 在你抽取一張[[怪物]]敵人時：該敵人不生成，改為放在一邊，視作在場外，在本密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。本效果可能導致當前密謀推進。
cards.back_text: If the investigators do not possess 3 [per_investigator] clues as a group, they lose all of their clues. If the investigators possess at least 3 [per_investigator] clues as a group, they must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues and spawn the set-aside Josef Meiger enemy at the location other than the Entry Hall that is farthest from all investigators. Open the Campaign Guide and proceed to Interlude I: A Record of Those Lost. Once this interlude has been resolved, remove all clues from each location in play, and advance to act 1b.
cards.back_text_cn: 調查員團隊如果未擁有3[per_investigator]個線索，則失去其所有線索。 調查員團隊如果有至少3[per_investigator]個線索，則其必須花費3[per_investigator]個線索，並將放在一邊的約瑟夫·梅吉爾敵人生成在除入口大廳以外離所有調查員最遠的地點。 打開冒險日誌，進入幕間故事I：失蹤人口記錄。 本幕間故事結束後，移除場上所有地點的全部線索，推進到場景1b。

cards.name: Over the Threshold
cards.text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy gains Victory 0, and counts as an investigator for the purpose of determining where hunter enemies move during the enemy phase. Forced - After the 'hunter enemies move' step of the enemy phase: Each ready [[Spectral]] enemy deals its damage value to each [[Humanoid]] enemy at its location.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[銀暮秘社]]敵人獲得勝利0，且在敵軍階段如要決定獵手敵人的移動方向，將其視為調查員。 強制 - 在敵軍階段的"獵手敵人移動"步驟後：所有準備狀態的[[幽靈]]敵人對同一地點的每個[[類人]]敵人造成等於自己傷害值的傷害。
cards.back_text: - If the investigators are at act 2, they are trapped inside the spectral realm. (→R3) - If the investigators are at act 3, they barely escape with their lives. Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: - 調查員如果在場景2，其被囚禁在幽靈國度。(→結局3) - 調查員如果在場景3，其勉強撿回了小命。每位未撒退的調查員被擊敗，並且受到1點肉體創傷。

cards.name: Hidden Agendas
cards.text: Objective - Find information about the disappearances by discovering as many clues as you can. (Do not advance until you are instructed.) (Hint: it may be worthwhile to investigate the last known locations of the missing persons.)
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 通過發現盡可能多的線索，找到有關失蹤事件的信息。(在收到指示之前，不要推進場景。) (提示：失蹤人口最後所在的地點或許值得一查。)
cards.back_text: Move each investigator and each enemy currently in the Entry Hall to the Victorian Halls. For each location in play, find the set-aside [[Spectral]] version of that location and swap them (all tokens and cards at the former location are now considered to be at the new location). If there is an investigator at that location, reveal it. In player order, each investigator spawns one of the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies at his or her location, until each of the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies has been spawned. Spawn the set-aside The Spectral Watcher enemy in the Entry Hall. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside The Watcher encounter set and the set-aside Realm of Death encounter set into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 將位於入口大廳的每位調查員和每個敵人移動到維多利亞式宴會廳。 從放在一邊的卡牌中，為場上的每個地點找出一張該地點的[[幽靈]]版本並替換(原地點上的所有標記和卡牌視為位於新版本地點)。如果該地點上有調查員，將其翻開。 按玩家順序，每位調查員將1個放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人生成在自己所在地點，直到所有放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人都已生成。 將放在一邊的幽靈看守人敵人生成在入口大廳。將放在一邊的看守人遭遇組的剩餘卡牌、冥界遭遇組的剩餘卡牌和遭遇棄牌堆一同洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Spectral Realm
cards.back_text:
The mist blocking your escape recedes. Reveal the Entry Hall.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn:
阻擋你逃離的迷霧漸漸散去。翻開入口大廳。
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Escape the Cage
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Entry Hall escapes; place them beneath the Entry Hall, out of play. Move each ready [[Silver Twilight]] enemy with the aloof keyword once toward the Entry Hall. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當一輪結束時：位於入口大廳的所有[[銀暮秘社]]敵人逃走；將其放在入口大廳底下，位於場外。將所有處於準備狀態且帶有冷漠關鍵詞的[[銀暮秘社]]敵人向入口大廳移動一次。 目標 - 如果所有未被擊敗的調查員均已撤退，推進場景。

cards.name: Entry Hall
cards.text: [action]: Resign. "I guess there is nothing to those disappearances after all."
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。"我覺得在這兒查不到失蹤事件的線索。"

cards.name: Victorian Halls
cards.text: [action]: You go looking for trouble. Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy in the Victorian Halls. Then, gain 2 clues (from the token pool). (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：你這是自找麻煩。從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到一張[[銀暮秘社]]敵人被丟棄。將該敵人生成在維多利亞式宴會廳。然後，從供應堆獲得2個線索。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Trophy Room
cards.text: [action]: You spend some time schmoozing with the other guests. Either gain 2 resources, or spend 2 resources to gain 1 clue (from the token pool). (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：你跟其他客人談了一會兒天。獲得2個資源，或花費2個資源來獲得1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Billiards Room
cards.text: [action]: Test [agility] (3) to compete with the other guests. If you succeed, gain 1 clue (from the token pool). (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：要與其他賓客來比一場，檢定[agility](3)。如果你成功，從供應堆獲得1個線索。如果你成功，從供應堆獲得1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Master Bedroom
cards.text: Forced - When the round ends, if there is at least 1 investigator in the Master Bedroom: Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Silver Twilight]] enemy.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在一輪結束時，如果主臥裡有至少1位調查員：在最近的[[銀暮秘社]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Balcony
cards.text: [action] Discard cards from your hand with a total of at least 3 [intellect] icons: Parley. The guest here knows more about the Lodge than they let on. Gain 2 clues (from the token pool). (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]丟棄你總計至少3個[intellect]圖標的手牌：談判。這裡的賓客實際上對銀暮秘社有更深的了解。從供應堆獲得2個線索。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Office
cards.text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Office lose aloof. Forced - If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol while investigating the Office: Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Silver Twilight]] enemy.
cards.text_cn: 位於辦公室的所有[[銀暮秘社]]敵人失去冷漠關鍵詞。 強制 - 如果你調查辦公室時抽出一個[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]標記：在最近的[[銀暮秘社]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in the Office loses aloof.
cards.back_text_cn: 位於辦公室的所有[[銀暮秘社]]敵人失去冷漠關鍵詞。

cards.name: Entry Hall
cards.text: [action]: Resign. You tear through the front doors of the manor, escaping the spectral realm and leaving the remainder of the survivors to their fate.
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你從莊園的前門破門而出，逃出了幽靈國度，讓其他人自生自滅。
cards.back_text: The Entry Hall is blocked by a wall of spectral mist. You cannot enter the Entry Hall. [[Silver Twilight]] enemies cannot spawn in the Entry Hall.
cards.back_text_cn: 鬼靈迷霧形成的壁障封鎖了入口大廳。你不能進入入口大廳。[[銀暮秘社]]敵人不能生成在入口大廳。

cards.name: Victorian Halls
cards.text: Haunted - Lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 失去1次行動。

cards.name: Trophy Room
cards.text: Haunted - Lose 2 resources. For each resource you cannot lose from this effect, take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 失去2資源。結算本效果時你每少失去1資源，受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Billiards Room
cards.text: Haunted - You must either discard an asset you control or take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 你必須丟棄你控制的1張支援或受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Master Bedroom
cards.text: Haunted - Place 1 of your clues on Master Bedroom.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 在主臥放置你的1個線索。

cards.name: Balcony
cards.text: Haunted - Each of your cards with health takes 1 direct damage.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 你每張帶有生命值的卡牌受到1點直接傷害。

cards.name: Office
cards.text: Haunted - Choose and discard a card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 選擇並丟棄你一張手牌。

cards.name: Josef's Plan
cards.text:
Remove all doom from this card.
For the remainder of the game, doom cannot be placed on [[Silver Twilight]] enemies, and Josef Meiger gains aloof.
Flip this card back to its enemy side and disengage it from all investigators.
cards.text_cn:
移除本卡牌上的所有毀滅標記。
在本局遊戲的剩餘時間裡，不能在[[銀暮秘社]]敵人上放置毀滅標記，約瑟夫·梅吉爾獲得冷漠關鍵詞。
本卡牌翻回敵人面，並解除與所有調查員的交戰狀態。

cards.name: The Spectral Watcher
cards.text: Alert. Hunter. Forced - When The Spectral Watcher is defeated: Instead of discarding it, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it. It does not ready during the upkeep phase this round.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。獵手。 強制 - 在幽靈看守人被擊敗時：不將其丟棄，改為治癒其所有傷害，解除與所有調查員的交戰狀態並消耗。在本輪補給階段期間，本卡牌不準備。

cards.name: Watcher's Grasp
cards.text: Revelation - Heal 3 damage from The Spectral Watcher. Ready The Spectral Watcher. It moves, engages, and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Throughout the resolution of this effect, The Spectral Watcher gains "Prey - You."
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 治癒幽靈看守人的3點傷害。準備幽靈看守人。幽靈看守人移動、交戰並攻擊，如同在敵軍階段。結算本效果期間，幽靈看守人獲得"獵物 - 你。"

cards.name: Piper of Azathoth
cards.text: Prey - Least remaining sanity. Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Piper of Azathoth attacks each investigator it is not engaged with at its location (regardless of whether it is ready or exhausted).
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 剩餘神智值最低的目標。 警戒。獵手。反擊。 強制 - 在敵軍階段結束時：阿撒托斯的吹笛手攻擊同地點未與其交戰的所有調查員(不論其是處於準備狀態或消耗狀態)。

cards.name: Daemonic Piping
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - If Piper of Azathoth is in play, deal 1 horror to each investigator at its location and at each connecting location. Otherwise, put Daemonic Piping into play next to the agenda deck. If there are 3 copies of Daemonic Piping in play, discard them and spawn the Piper of Azathoth engaged with its prey (from any out of play area).
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 如果場上有阿撒托斯的吹笛手，對其所在地點和所有連接地點的每位調查員造成1點恐懼。否則，將魔鬼的笛聲放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 如果場上有3張魔鬼的笛聲，丟棄這3張卡牌，阿撒托斯的吹笛手生成並與其獵物交戰(從場外的任意區域生成)。

cards.name: Coven Initiate
cards.text: Revelation - Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck. If this effect causes the encounter deck to run out of cards, draw the topmost [[Hex]] card in the encounter discard pile.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的2張卡牌。如果本效果導致遭於牌堆的卡牌耗盡，抽取遭遇棄牌堆最頂上的1張[[巫術]]卡牌。

cards.name: Priestess of the Coven
cards.text: Retaliate. Priestess of the Coven gets +1 fight and +1 evade for each [[Witch]] enemy in the encounter discard pile (to a maximum of +3 fight and +3 evade). Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Priestess of the Coven readies and attacks each investigator at its location.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 遭遇棄牌堆每有一個[[女巫]]敵人，女巫集會的女祭司+1攻擊值和+1躲避值(最多+3攻擊值和+3躲避值)。 強制 - 在遭遇牌堆的卡牌耗盡時：女巫集會的女祭司準備並攻擊同地點的每位調查員。

cards.name: Diabolic Voices
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, discard 1 random card from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 horror or 1 damage. This test gets +1 difficulty for each copy of Diabolic Voices in the encounter discard pile.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，隨機丟棄1張手牌。你每有一張卡牌無法丟棄，受到1點恐懼或1點傷害。遭遇棄牌堆每有1張惡魔之音，本次檢定難度+1。

cards.name: Wracked
cards.text: Revelation - Put Wracked into play in your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills during the first skill test you perform each round. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Wracked. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將崩毀離析放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 你每輪執行的第一個技能檢定期間，你每項技能值-1。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄崩毀離析。如果你所在地點有處於消耗狀態的[[女巫]]敵人，本次檢定自動成功。

cards.name: Bedeviled
cards.text: Revelation - Put Bedeviled into play in your threat area. You cannot trigger [action] abilities on cards you control. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Bedeviled. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將苦痛折磨放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 你不能觸發自己控制的卡牌上的[action]能力。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄苦痛折磨。如果你所在地點有處於消耗狀態的[[女巫]]敵人，本次檢定自動成功。

cards.name: Lodge Neophyte
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. Aloof. Forced - After Lodge Neophyte enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, remove all doom from Lodge Neophyte.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個無人地點。 冷漠。 強制 - 在秘社新信徒入場後：在其身上放置1個毀滅標記。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](2)。如果你成功，移除秘社新信徒上的所有毀滅標記。

cards.name: Keeper of Secrets
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. Aloof. Retaliate. Forced - When the mythos phase ends: Place 1 doom on Keeper of Secrets. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, remove all doom from Keeper of Secrets.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個無人地點。 冷漠。反擊。 強制 - 在神話階段結束時：將1個毀滅標記放在守密人上。 [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，移除守密人上的所有毀滅標記。

cards.name: Mysteries of the Lodge
cards.text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy. Then, until the end of the round, increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with that enemy by 2. If no doom is placed by this effect, Mysteries of the Lodge gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 在最近的[[異教徒]]敵人身上放置1個毀滅標記。然後，本輪結束前，對該敵人攻擊、躲避或談判的難度加2。如果本效果未放置毀滅標記，秘社玄儀獲得湧動。

cards.name: Evil Past
cards.text: Revelation - Put Evil Past into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Evil Past and it gains surge instead). Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Take 2 horror and test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Evil Past.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你的威脅區域裡沒有邪惡往昔，將其放置入場，位於你的威脅區域(如果已有邪惡往昔，改為將本卡牌丟棄並獲得湧動)。 強制 - 在遭遇牌堆的卡牌耗盡時：受到2點恐懼並檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄邪惡往昔。

cards.name: Centuries of Secrets
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, discard the top card of the encounter deck. If a [[Curse]] treachery is discarded by this effect, deal 1 direct damage to your investigator and to each of your [[Ally]] assets.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](5)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。如果本效果丟棄了[[詛咒]]詭計，對你的調查員和你的每個[[盟友]]支援造成1點直接傷害。

cards.name: Nether Mist
cards.text: Prey - Investigator at the location with the most clues. Aloof. Hunter. Nether Mist's location gains: "Haunted - Nether Mist attacks you."
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 所在地點線索最多的調查員。 冷漠。獵手。 冥府之霧所在地點獲得："鬧鬼 - 冥府之霧攻擊你。"

cards.name: Shadow Hound
cards.text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Shadow Hound attacks you: Resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - [agility]最低的目標。 獵手。反擊。 強制 - 在暗影獵犬攻擊你後：結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: Whispers in the Dark
cards.text: Revelation - Put Whispers in the Dark into play next to the agenda deck. Each location gains: "Haunted - Take 1 horror." Forced - When the round ends: Discard Whispers in the Dark.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將黑暗中的低語放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 每個地點獲得："鬧鬼 - 受到1點恐懼。" 強制 - 在一輪結束時：丟棄黑暗中的低語。

cards.name: Wraith
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When Wraith is defeated by damage (except from a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]]): Instead of discarding it, attach it to its location. Attached location gains: "Haunted - Spawn Wraith at this location."
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 在怨靈受到(來自[[法術]]或[[遺物]]以外的)傷害而被擊敗時：不將其丟棄，改為將其疊加到其所在地點。疊加的地點獲得："鬧鬼 - 在本地點生成怨靈。"

cards.name: Trapped Spirits
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage. If your location is haunted, as an additional cost for an investigator to commit 1 or more cards to this skill test, he or she must resolve each haunted ability on this location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點傷害。如果你所在地點鬧鬼，一位調查員如要在本次技能檢定投入1張或多張卡牌，作為額外費用，該調查員必須結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: Realm of Torment
cards.text: Revelation - Put Realm of Torment into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn begins: Resolve each haunted ability on your location. Forced - When your turn ends: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Realm of Torment.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將苦痛之地放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你回合開始時：結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。 強制 - 在你回合結束時：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄苦痛之地。

cards.name: Shapes in the Mist
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - Resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: Terror in the Night
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, put Terror in the Night into play next to the agenda deck. If you fail by 3 or more, Terror in the Night gains surge. If there are 3 copies of Terror in the Night next to the agenda deck, discard them and each investigator takes 3 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)。如果你失敗，將恐怖夜色放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁。如果你失敗且低於難度至少3點，恐怖夜色獲得湧動。 如果密謀牌堆旁有3張恐怖夜色，將其丟棄，每位調查員受到3點恐懼。

cards.name: Fate of All Fools
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - If there is no other copy of Fate of All Fools in play, put Fate of All Fools into play in your threat area. - An investigator with another copy of Fate of All Fools in his or her threat area takes 2 direct damage. - Place 1 doom on another copy of Fate of All Fools.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)： - 如果場上沒有其他愚人的命運，將愚人的命運放置入場，位於你的威脅區域。 - 威脅區域內有另一張愚人的命運的1位調查員受到2點直接傷害。 - 在另一張愚人的命運上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: The Secret Name
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at an [[Extradimensional]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and Nahab is at your location, she attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位於[[異次元]]地點，改為-3)。
[cultist]：再抽一個混亂標記。如果你失敗，丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的3張卡牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果你失敗且那赫卜在你的地點，她攻擊你。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，結算場上每個敵人的獵手關鍵詞。
cards.back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at an [[Extradimensional]] location). [cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail, discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. [tablet]: -3. If you fail and Nahab is in play, she attacks you (regardless of her current location). [elder_thing]: -4. Resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-2(如果你位於[[異次元]]地點，改為-4)。 [cultist]：再抽一個混亂標記。如果你失敗，丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌。 [tablet]：-3。如果你失敗且那赫卜在場，她攻擊你。(無視她當前地點)。 [elder_thing]：-4。結算場上每個敵人的獵手關鍵詞。

cards.name: THE HERMIT • IX
cards.text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +1 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).
cards.text_cn:
每個非弱點敵人+1生命值。
[reaction]在你擊敗布朗·詹金或那赫卜後：從供應堆獲得1個線索(如果有至少3位調查員參與本場遊戲，改為2個線索)。
cards.back_text:
If Brown Jenkin is in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in Brown Jenkin's location. If Brown Jenkin is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him and spawn it in the lead investigator's location.
Additionally, if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in any [[Witch House]] location.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果布朗·詹金位於場上，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張鼠群，將其生成在布朗·詹金所在地點。如果布朗·詹金不在場上，從遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆將其找出，並生成在調查員隊長所在地點。
除此之外，如果有3或4位調查員參與本場遊戲，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出一張鼠群，將其生成在任意一個[[巫宅]]地點。

cards.name: The Familiar
cards.text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +2 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).
cards.text_cn:
每個非弱點敵人+2生命值。
[reaction]在你擊敗布朗·詹金或那赫卜後：從供應堆獲得1個線索(如果有至少3位調查員參與本場遊戲，改為2個線索)。
cards.back_text:
- If it is act 1, spawn the set-aside Nahab in Walter Gilman's Room.
- If it is act 2, spawn the set-aside Nahab in Keziah's Room.
- If it is act 3, place 1 doom on Nahab.
Shuffle both set-aside copies of Ghostly Presence into the encounter deck.
Find Brown Jenkin (even if he is out of play) and place him in Nahab's current location.
cards.back_text_cn:
- 如果當前場景為場景1，將放在一邊的那赫卜生成在沃爾特·吉爾曼的房間。
- 如果當前場景為場景2，將放在一邊的那赫卜生成在凱夏的房間。
- 如果當前場景為場景3，在那赫卜上放置1個毀滅標記。
將放在一邊的2張鬼影驟現洗入遭遇牌堆。找出布朗·詹金(不論他是否位於場上)，將其放在那赫卜當前所在地點。

cards.name: The Witch Light
cards.text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +3 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue from the token bank (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).
cards.text_cn:
每個非弱點敵人+3生命值。
[reaction]在你擊敗布朗·詹金或那赫卜後：從供應堆獲得1個線索(如果有至少3位調查員參與本場遊戲，改為2個線索)。
cards.back_text:
- If it is act 1 or 2, set Nahab aside, out of play, and place 4 doom on agenda 4a as it enters play.
- If it is act 3, place 1 doom on Nahab.
cards.back_text_cn:
- 如果當前場景為場景1或場景2，將那赫卜放在一邊，位於場外，密謀4a入場時在其上面放置4個毀滅標記。
- 如果當前場景為場景3，在那赫卜上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Marked for Sacrifice
cards.text:
Each non-weakness enemy gets +4 health.
[reaction] After you defeat Brown Jenkin or Nahab: Gain 1 clue (2 clues instead if there are 3 or more investigators in the game).
cards.text_cn:
每個非弱點敵人+4生命值。
[reaction]在你擊敗布朗·詹金或那赫卜後：從供應堆獲得1個線索(如果有至少3位調查員參與本場遊戲，改為2個線索)。

cards.name: Investigating the Witch House
cards.text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is in Walter Gilman's Room, investigators may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果所有未被擊敗的調查員都位於沃爾特·吉爾曼的房間，調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Swap Walter Gilman's Room with the set-aside Keziah's Room, taking its place (all tokens and cards at the former location are now at the new location). Remove each other location in play from the game. Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside The Black Book asset. Shuffle both set-aside copies of Strange Geometry into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的凱夏的房間替換沃爾特·吉爾曼的房間(原地點上的所有標記和卡牌視為位於新地點)。將場上的其他所有地點從遊戲中移除。 選擇一位調查員來控制放在一邊的黑書支援卡。將放在一邊的2張古怪圖形洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Beyond the Witch House
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators in the Witch House Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有在巫宅遺址的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Put the set-aside Site of the Sacrifice location into play.
- If it is agenda 1, 2, or 3, find Nahab (even if she is out of play), place 2 doom on her, and place her at the Site of the Sacrifice.
- If it is agenda 4, find Nahab (even if she is out of play) and place her at the Site of the Sacrifice. Move each doom from agenda 4a to Nahab.
Find Brown Jenkin (even if he is out of play) and place him in Nahab's current location.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的獻祭場所地點放置入場。
- 如果當前密謀為密謀1、密謀2或密謀3，找出那赫卜(不論其是否在場上)，在其身上放置2個毀滅標記，將其放在獻祭場所。
- 如果當前密謀為密謀4，找出那赫卜(不論其是否在場上)，將其放在獻祭場所。將密謀4a上的所有毀滅標記移動到那赫卜身上。
找出布朗·詹金(不論他是否位於場上)，將其放在那赫卜當前所在地點。

cards.name: Stopping the Ritual
cards.text: Nahab cannot leave the Site of the Sacrifice. Forced - When Nahab is defeated: Instead of discarding her, heal all damage from her, disengage her from all investigators, and exhaust her. She does not ready during the upkeep phase this round. Objective - If there is no doom on Nahab, advance.
cards.text_cn: 那赫卜不能離開獻祭場所。 強制 - 在那赫卜被擊敗時：不將其棄掉，改為其治癒所有傷害，解除與所有調查員的交戰狀態並消耗。在本輪補給階段期間，那赫卜不準備。 目標 - 如果那赫卜上沒有毀滅標記，推進場景。

cards.name: Moldy Halls
cards.text: Haunted - Lose 3 resources.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 失去3資源。

cards.name: Landlord's Quarters
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal Landlord's Quarters: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in Moldy Halls. Shuffle the encounter deck. Haunted - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats and spawn it in Moldy Halls. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你翻開屋主的住處後：從遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆找出一張鼠群，將其生成在發霉的走道。混洗遭遇牌堆。 鬧鬼 - 從遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆找出一張鼠群，將其生成在發霉的走道。混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Joe Mazurewicz's Room
cards.text: [action]: Search your deck for a [[Blessed]] or [[Item]] asset and add it to your hand. (Group limit once per game.) Haunted - You must either take 1 horror, or choose and discard an asset you control.
cards.text_cn: [action]：查找你的牌組，找出一張[[祝福]]或[[道具]]支援卡，將其加入你手牌。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。) 鬧鬼 - 你必須受到1點恐懼，或者選擇並丟棄你控制的1張支援。

cards.name: Frank Elwood's room
cards.name_cn: 弗蘭克·埃爾伍德的房間
cards.text: Haunted - You must either place 1 of your clues on Frank Elwood's Room, or place 1 doom on the current agenda.
cards.text_cn: 鬧鬼 - 你必須在弗蘭克·埃爾伍德的房間放置你的1個線索，或在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Walter Gilman's Room
cards.text: [action]: Draw 3 cards and take 1 horror. (Limit once per game.) Haunted - Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: [action]：抽取3張卡牌並受到1點恐懼。(每場遊戲限制一次。) 鬧鬼 -丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的2張卡牌。
cards.back_text: The door to Walter Gilman's room is locked. As an additional cost to enter Walter Gilman's room, investigators in the Moldy Halls must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 沃爾特·吉爾曼的房間鎖上了。作為進入沃爾特·吉爾曼的房間的額外費用，位於發霉的走道的調查員必須以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Keziah's Room
cards.text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Keziah's Room: Instead of discovering clues, put the top card of the Unknown Places deck into play, unrevealed. Then, you may move to that location. Haunted - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Hex]] card is discarded. Draw that card.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你成功調查凱夏的房間後：不發現線索，改為將"未知地點"牌堆頂上的1張卡牌以未揭示面朝上，放置入場。然後，你可以移動到該地點。 鬧鬼 - 從遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到一張[[巫術]]卡牌被丟棄。抽取該卡牌。

cards.name: Moldy Halls
cards.text: [action]: You request aid from your past self. Each investigator at this location may return 1 card from his or her discard pile to his or her hand. Each investigator who does so remembers that he or she "meddled with the past." (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：你向過去的自己尋求幫助。本地點上的每位調查員可以將自己棄牌堆的1張卡牌返回其手牌。每位這麼做的調查員記住自己"沉湎過去"。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Twilight Abyss
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Twilight Abyss, test [combat] or [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入暮光深淵後，檢定檢定[combat]或[agility](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: City of Elder Things
cards.text: [reaction] After you reveal City of Elder Things, take 2 horror: Put the top card of the Unknown Places deck into play, unrevealed. For the remainder of the scenario, City of Elder Things is considered to be connected to that location, and vice versa.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你翻開遠古之城後，受到2點恐懼：將"未知地點"牌堆頂上的1張卡牌以未揭示面朝上，放置入場。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，遠古之城被視為與該地點互相連接。

cards.name: Witch House Ruins
cards.text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, heal 2 horror. (Limit once per game.) Haunted - Lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: [action]：調查。如果你成功，不發現線索，改為治癒2點恐懼。(每場遊戲限制一次。) 鬧鬼 - 失去1次行動。

cards.name: Salem Gaol, 1692
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, move to any revealed location. (Limit once per game.) Haunted- Move to Keziah's Room.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，移動到任意一個已揭示的地點。(每場遊戲限制一次。) 鬧鬼 - 移動到凱夏的房間.

cards.name: Physics Classroom
cards.text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Physics Classroom by 2 or more: Discover a clue at another revealed location. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你成功調查物理教室，且超過檢定難度至少2點後：發現另一個已揭示地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Court of the Great Old Ones
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Court of the Great Old Ones, test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. Haunted - The next action you perform this round must be an investigate action.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入舊日支配者皇廷後，檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼。 鬧鬼 - 你本輪執行的下一個行動必須是調查行動。

cards.name: Site of the Sacrifice
cards.text: [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remove 1 doom from Nahab. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from Nahab. Forced - At the end of the round: Add clues to this location until it has 3 [per_investigator] clues on it. Haunted - You must either place 1 doom on Nahab, or Nahab attacks you.
cards.text_cn: [action]在本地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：移除那赫卜的1個毀滅標記。此行動不會引起那赫卜的趁亂攻擊。 強制 - 當本輪結束時：在本地點上增加線索，直到其上有3[per_investigator]個線索。 鬧鬼 - 你必須在那赫卜上面放置1個毀滅標記，或那赫卜攻擊你。

cards.name: Strange Geometry
cards.text: Revelation - Put Strange Geometry into play and move to it. Forced - After the investigation phase ends: Discard Strange Geometry and move each investigator and enemy here to the location with the most clues. Each investigator who moved by this effect takes 1 damage and 1 horror. [fast] If Strange Geometry has no clues on it: Move to any revealed location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將古怪圖形放置入場，並移動到該地點。 強制 - 在調查階段結束後：丟棄古怪圖形，位於古怪圖形的所有調查員和敵人移動到最多線索的地點。每位被本效果移動的調查員受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。 [free]如果古怪圖形上沒有線索：移動到任意一個已揭示的地點。

cards.name: Meddlesome Familiar
cards.text: Revelation - If Brown Jenkin is not in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for him, spawn him at your location, and take 1 damage. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Rats, spawn it engaged with you, then take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果布朗·詹金不在場上，從遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆將其找出，生成在你所在地點，你受到1點傷害。否則，從遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆找出一張鼠群，將其生成並與你交戰，然後你受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Ghostly Presence
cards.text: Revelation - If Nahab is in play, ready her, resolve her hunter keyword, and she attacks each investigator at her location. If Nahab is at the Site of the Sacrifice, place 1 doom on her, as well. Otherwise, search the encounter deck and discard pile for Nahab and spawn her at your location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果那赫卜在場上，將其準備，結算其獵手關鍵詞，其攻擊自己所在地點上的所有調查員。如果那赫卜位於獻祭場所，則再在她身上放置1個毀滅標記。否則，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出那赫卜，將其生成在你所在地點。

cards.name: Extradimensional Visions
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for every 10 cards in the encounter discard pile. If you fail, discard an asset you control.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。遭遇棄牌堆每有10張卡牌，本次檢定難度+1。如果你失敗，丟棄你控制的1張支援卡。

cards.name: Pulled by the Stars
cards.text: Revelation - Put Pulled by the Stars into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not move at least once during your turn: Take 2 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Pulled by the Stars from play. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將群星牽引放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 當你回合結束時，如果你本回合未移動至少1次：受到2點恐懼。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，將群星牽引從場上丟棄。如果你所在地點有處於消耗狀態的[[女巫]]敵人，本次檢定自動成功。

cards.name: Disquieting Dreams
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). If you fail, put Disquieting Dreams into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. Forced - When the encounter deck runs out of cards: Discard Disquieting Dreams and reveal the top 10 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness revealed and discard each other revealed card.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](5)。如果你失敗，將不安的夢放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 當你回合結束時：丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。 強制 - 在遭遇牌堆的卡牌耗盡時：丟棄不安的夢，翻開你牌堆頂部的10張卡牌。在翻開的卡牌中，抽取所有弱點，丟棄其餘卡牌。

cards.name: Brown Jenkin
cards.text: Aloof. Hunter. Each ready [[Creature]] enemy gets +2 fight. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if Brown Jenkin is ready: Each investigator at his location discards his or her hand, then draws that many cards.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。獵手。 每個準備狀態的[[生物]]敵人+2攻擊值。 強制 - 在敵軍階段結束時，如果布朗·詹金為準備狀態：他所在地點上的每位調查員丟棄自己的手牌，然後抽取等量卡牌。

cards.name: Nahab
cards.text: Hunter. Retaliate. Do not remove doom from Nahab when the agenda advances. Nahab gets +X fight, where X is the number of the current agenda. Forced - After the enemy phase begins, if Nahab is ready: Place 1 doom on her.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。反擊。 在密謀推進時，不要移除那赫卜的毀滅標記。 那赫卜+X攻擊值，其中X為當前密謀卡編號。 強制 - 在敵軍階段開始後，如果那赫卜為準備狀態：在其上放置1個毀滅標記。

meta.subname: She Who Signed the Black Book

cards.name: The Black Book
cards.text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When you play a card, exhaust The Black Book and take X horror: Reduce that card's cost by X.
cards.text_cn:
你+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在你打出一張卡牌時，消耗黑書並受到X點恐懼：該卡牌的費用減少X點。

cards.name: The Wages of Sin
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is 1 higher than the number of copies of Unfinished Business in the victory display.
[cultist]: -3. Until the end of the round, each Heretic enemy in play gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, trigger the forced ability on a copy of Unfinished Business in yout threat area as if it were the end of the round.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X等於勝利牌區內的未了之事的數量+1。
[cultist]：-3。本輪結束前，場上每個異端者敵人+1攻擊值和+1躲避值。
[tablet]：-3。如果你失敗，觸發你威脅區域的一張未了之事上的強制能力，如同此時是一輪結束。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你失敗且本次檢定為攻擊或躲避嘗試，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of copies of Unfinished Business in the victory display. Reveal another token.
[cultist]: -4. Until the end of the round, each Heretic enemy in play gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, trigger the forced ability on a copy of Unfinished Business in your threat area as if it were the end of the round.
[elder_thing]: -2. If this is an attack or evasion attempt, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X等於勝利牌區內的未了之事的數量。再抽出一個標記。
[cultist]：-4。本輪結束前，場上每個異端者敵人+1攻擊值和+1躲避值。
[tablet]：-4。如果你失敗，觸發你威脅區域的一張未了之事上的強制能力，如同此時是一輪結束。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果本次檢定為攻擊或躲避嘗試，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: THE HANGED MAN · XII
cards.back_text: Flip each location to its [[Spectral]] side. Put the set-aside The Spectral Watcher enemy into play at Hangman's Brook. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside The Watcher encounter set into the spectral encounter deck, along with the spectral discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 將每個地點翻到其[[幽靈]]面。 將放在一邊的幽靈看守人敵人放置入場，位於絞刑者河。 將放在一邊的看守人遭遇組和幽靈棄牌堆一同洗入幽靈遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Death's Approach
cards.text: Locations cannot be flipped to their non-[[Spectral]] side.
cards.text_cn: 地點不能被翻到非[[幽靈]]面。(FAQ, v1.6)

cards.name: In Pursuit of the Dead
cards.text: Locations cannot be flipped to their [[Spectral]] side.
cards.text_cn: 地點不能被翻到[[幽靈]]面。(FAQ, v1.6)
cards.back_text:
Spawn 1 set-aside Heretic enemy at each of the following locations: The Gallows, Heretics' Graves, Chapel Attic, and Chapel Crypt. Add 2 [per_investigator] clues to each of those locations. Add 1 [per_investigator] clues to each other location.
Check Campaign Log. If you have 3 or more mementos listed under "Mementos Discovered:" You understand the tragic lyrics behind the witch's song. Each investigator puts into play 1 set-aside Spectral Web asset, under his or her control.
cards.back_text_cn:
在以下每個地點生成放在一邊的1個異端者敵人：絞刑架、異端者的墓地、教堂閣樓、教堂地下室。在上述每個地點添加2[per_investigator]個線索。在其他每個地點添加[per_investigator]個線索。
查看冒險日誌。如果"遺留記憶"下方所列等於或大於3項：你聽懂了女巫所唱歌曲中的悲傷歌詞。每位調查員將放在一邊的1張幽靈迷網支援卡放置入場，置於其控制之下。

cards.name: In Pursuit of the Living
cards.text: [fast]: Flip your location over. (Group limit once per round at each location.) Clues cannot be discovered at non-[[Spectral]] locations. Objective - Banish as many Heretics as you can. If there are 4 copies of Unfinished Business in the victory display, advance.
cards.text_cn: [free]：將你所在地點翻面。(團隊每輪在每個地點限制一次。) 不能在非[[幽靈]]地點發現線索。 目標 - 驅除盡可能多的異端者。如果勝利牌區有4張未了之事，推進場景。
cards.back_text: In your Campaign Log, under "Mementos Discovered," record Corn Husk Doll. (→R1)
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌"遺留記憶"下方記錄下玉米皮娃娃。 (→結局1)

cards.name: Hangman's Brook
cards.text: [action]: Resign. "Whose bright idea was this, anyway?"
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。"這個好主意是誰想出來的？"

cards.name: Haunted Fields
cards.text: Each [[Spectral]] enemy at Haunted Fields gets +1 horror value.
cards.text_cn: 位於鬧鬼農田的每個[[幽靈]]敵人+1恐懼值。

cards.name: Abandoned Chapel
cards.text: During the mythos phase, each investigator in Abandoned Chapel gets -1 to each skill.
cards.text_cn: 在神話階段，每位位於廢棄教堂的調查員的每項技能值-1。

cards.name: The Gallows
cards.text: The Gallows gets +1 shroud for each [[Witch]] enemy in play.
cards.text_cn: 每有一個[[女巫]]敵人位於場上，絞刑架+1隱藏值。

cards.name: The Gallows
cards.text: X is the number of [[Geist]] enemies in play.
cards.text_cn: X為場上的[[靈怪]]敵人數量。

cards.name: Heretics' Graves
cards.text: While investigating Heretics' Graves, add your [willpower] value to your skill value for the investigation.
cards.text_cn: 調查異端者的墓地時，將你的[willpower]增加到你本次調查的技能值。

cards.name: Heretics' Graves
cards.text: Forced - After a [[Witch]] enemy at Heretics' Graves is defeated: Discard the top 2 cards of the standard encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在一個[[女巫]]敵人在異端者的墓地被擊敗後：丟棄基礎遭遇牌堆頂的2張卡牌。

cards.name: Chapel Crypt
cards.text: While there are no ready enemies at Chapel Crypt, it gets -3 shroud.
cards.text_cn: 只要教堂地下室沒有處於準備狀態的敵人，教堂地下室隱藏值-3。

cards.name: Chapel Crypt
cards.text: While there are no [[Hex]] treacheries among investigators' threat areas at Chapel Crypt, it gets -3 shroud.
cards.text_cn: 只要位於教堂地下室的調查員威脅區域內沒有[[巫術]]詭計卡，教堂地下室隱藏值-3。

cards.name: Chapel Attic
cards.text: Forced - After you draw a non-weakness card from your deck while at Chapel Attic: Place that card facedown beneath Chapel Attic, out of play. [reaction] After you successfully investigate Chapel Attic: Add each card beneath it to its owner's hand.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你位於教堂閣樓時從自己牌堆抽取一張非弱點卡牌後：將該卡牌正面朝下放在教堂閣樓底下，位於場外。 [reaction]在你成功調查教堂閣樓後：將其底下的所有卡牌加入其所有者的手牌。

cards.name: Chapel Attic
cards.text: While investigating Chapel Attic, add the number of cards in your hand to your skill value for the investigation.
cards.text_cn: 調查教堂閣樓時，你本次調查的技能值加上你的手牌張數。

cards.name: Spectral Web
cards.text: [action] Investigators at your location spend 1-3 clues, as a group: Fight. Use this ability only to attack a [[Geist]] enemy. You may choose to use your [willpower] instead of your [combat] for this attack. You get +X skill value and deal +X damage for this attack, where X is the amount of clues spent to trigger this ability.
cards.text_cn: [action]你所在地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費1到3個線索：攻擊。本能力只能用於攻擊[[靈怪]]敵人。你在本次攻擊中可以不使用[combat]，改為使用[willpower]。你在本次攻擊中技能值+X，造成+X傷害，其中X是觸發本能力所花費的線索數量。

cards.name: Heretic
cards.text: Heretic gets +2 [per_investigator] health. While Heretic is at a non-[[Spectral]] location, it gains aloof and cannot be engaged or damaged. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Parley. Look at Heretic's other side (without resolving its text). Forced - After Heretic is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 異端者+2[per_investigator]生命值。 只要異端者位於非[[幽靈]]地點，其獲得冷漠關鍵詞，不能交戰也不會受到傷害。 [free]花費1個線索：談判。查看異端者的另一面(不要結算其文字)。 強制 - 在異端者被擊敗後：將其翻至另一面並且結算該面的文字。

cards.name: Vengeful Witch
cards.text: Spawn - The Gallows or Heretics' Graves. Alert. Hunter. Forced - When Vengeful Witch is defeated: Deal its damage and horror to each investigator at its location, as direct damage/horror.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 絞刑架或異端者的墓地。 警戒。獵手。 強制 - 在復仇女巫被擊敗時：對其所在地點的每位調查員造成其傷害和恐懼，作為直接傷害/直接恐懼。

cards.name: Malevolent Spirit
cards.text: Spawn - Chapel Attic or Chapel Crypt. While Malevolent Spirit is at a [[Spectral]] location, it gains hunter and gets +1 damage value and +1 horror value. Forced - When Malevolent Spirit is defeated by damage (except from a [[Spell]] or [[Relic]]): Instead of discarding it, heal all damage from it, exhaust it, and move it to any [[Spectral]] location, if able.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 教堂閣樓或教堂地下室。 只要惡毒邪靈位於[[幽靈]]地點，其獲得獵手關鍵詞，傷害值+1，恐懼值+1。 強制 - 在惡毒邪靈因(除法術或遭遺物以外的)傷害而被擊敗時：不將其丟棄，改為其治癒所有傷害，將其消耗，如果可能，將其移動到任意一個[[幽靈]]地點。

cards.name: Punishment
cards.text: Revelation - Put Punishment into play in your threat area. Forced - After an enemy at any location is defeated: Take 1 damage. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Punishment. If there is an exhausted [[Witch]] enemy at your location, this test is automatically successful.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將懲罰放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在任意一個地點有敵人被擊敗後：受到1點傷害。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄懲罰。如果你所在地點有處於消耗狀態的[[女巫]]敵人，本次檢定自動成功。

cards.name: Burdens of the Past
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no copies of Unfinished Business in your threat area, Burdens of the Past gains surge. Otherwise, trigger the forced ability of each copy of Unfinished Business in your threat area as if it were the end of the round.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你的威脅區域沒有未了之事，往昔重擔獲得湧動。否則，觸發你威脅區域每張未了之事上的強制能力，如同此時是一輪結束。

cards.name: Ominous Portents
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Draw the top card of the spectral encounter deck. That card gains peril, and its effects cannot be canceled. - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)： - 抽取幽靈遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。該卡牌獲得禍害，其卡牌效果不能被取消。 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Grave-Light
cards.text: Revelation - If Grave-Light is drawn ... - ...from the standard encounter deck, shuffle it into the spectral encounter deck, and it gains surge. - ...from the spectral encounter deck, take 2 damage and place it in the standard encounter discard pile.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果調查員抽出了長明燈…… - ……並且是從基礎遭遇牌堆抽出，將其洗入幽靈遭遇牌堆，且其獲得湧動。 - ……並且是從幽靈遭遇牌堆抽出，受到2點傷害，將其放到基礎遭遇棄牌堆。

cards.name: Bane of the Living
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Choose an Unfinished Business card in play, flip it to its Heretic side, and place damage on it equal to half its health. - Discard cards from the top of the spectral encounter deck until a [[Geist]] enemy is discarded. Spawn that enemy engaged with you.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)： - 選擇場上的一張未了之事，將其翻面至異端者面，在其上放置數量等於其生命值一半的傷害標記。 - 從幽靈遭遇牌堆頂棄牌，直到棄掉一個[[靈怪]]敵人。該敵人生成並與你交戰。

cards.name: For the Greater Good
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest number of doom on a [[Cultist]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. Reveal another token.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, move 1 doom from the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy to the current agenda.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為場上帶有最多毀滅標記的[[異教徒]]敵人的毀滅標記數量。
[cultist]：-2。再抽出一個標記。
[tablet]：-3。如果你失敗，在最近的[[異教徒]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，從最近的[[異教徒]]敵人上將1個毀滅標記移動到當前密謀。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the total number of doom among [[Cultist]] enemies in play.
[cultist]: -2. Reveal another token.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy in play. If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, reveal another token.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, move all doom from the [[Cultist]] enemy with the most doom on it to the current agenda. If no [[Cultist]] enemies in play have doom on them, reveal another token.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為場上[[異教徒]]敵人上的毀滅標記總數。
[cultist]：-2。再抽出一個標記。
[tablet]：-3。如果你失敗，在場上每個[[異教徒]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。如果場上沒有[[異教徒]]敵人，再抽出一個標記。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，將擁有最多毀滅標記的[[異教徒]]敵人的所有毀滅標記移動到當前密謀。如果場上的[[異教徒]]敵人都沒有毀滅標記，再抽出1個標記。

cards.name: THE HIEROPHANT · V
cards.text: Forced - When you defeat a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy: You leave behind some evidence of the scuffle. Move 1 doom from each enemy at that location to the current agenda.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你擊敗一個[[銀暮秘社]]敵人時：你匆忙之中遺漏了一些證據。將位於該地點的每個敵人的1個毀滅標記移動到當前密謀。
cards.back_text: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck. In player order, each investigator must draw a [[Cultist]] enemy discarded in this way.
cards.back_text_cn: 丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌。調查員必須按玩家順序每人抽取1張以此方式丟棄的[[異教徒]]敵人。

cards.name: Ends and Means
cards.text: Each [[Silver Twilight]] enemy in a [[Sanctum]] location loses aloof. Forced - When you defeat a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy: You leave behind some evidence of the scuffle. Move 1 doom from each enemy at that location to the current agenda.
cards.text_cn: 位於[[聖堂]]地點的所有很[[銀暮秘社]]敵人失去冷漠關鍵詞。 強制 - 在你擊敗一個[[銀暮秘社]]敵人時：你匆忙之中遺漏了一些證據。將位於該地點的每個敵人的1個毀滅標記移動到當前密謀。
cards.back_text: Revelation - Replace the act and agenda decks with The Greater Good. Spawn the set-aside Summoned Beast at the Puzzle Box's location (or any [[Sanctum]] location if the Puzzle Box is not in play) and remove the Puzzle Box from the game.
cards.back_text_cn: 顯現 - 用崇高的利益取代場景和密謀牌堆。將放在一邊的響應召喚的怪獸生成在機關盒所在地點(如果機關盒不在場上，改為生成在任意一個[[聖堂]]地點)，將機關盒移出遊戲。

cards.name: Warm Welcome
cards.back_text: If the Library is not in play, put it into play. Spawn the set-aside Nathan Wick enemy in the Library, (Master of Initiation) side faceup. Attach the set-aside Puzzle Box story asset to him.
cards.back_text_cn: 如果藏書室不在場上，將其放置入場。 將放在一邊的南森·威克敵人生成在藏書室，(引導大師)面朝上放置。將放在一邊的機關盒疊加到他身上。

cards.name: Infiltrating the Lodge
cards.text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy: Remove all doom from it.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你躲避一個敵人後：移除其所有毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: If the Inner Sanctum is not in play, put it into play. Spawn the set-aside Nathan Wick enemy in the Inner Sanctum, (Master of Indoctrination) side faceup. Attach the set-aside Puzzle Box story asset to him. For the remainder of the game, the current act gains "[reaction] After you evade an enemy: Remove all doom from it." Place this card next to the act deck as a reminder, then advance to act 2a.
cards.back_text_cn: 如果聖堂內室不在場上，將其放置入場。 將放在一邊的南森·威克敵人生成在聖堂內室，(教化大師)面朝上放置。將放在一邊的機關盒疊加到他身上。 本場遊戲剩餘時間內，當前場景獲得："[reaction]在你躲避一個敵人後：移除其所有毀滅標記。"將本卡牌放到場景牌堆旁邊以作提醒，然後推進至場景2a。

cards.name: Obtaining the Device
cards.text: Objective - If Nathan Wick is added to the victory display by any means, choose an investigator to take control of the attached Puzzle Box, and advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果南森·威克以任何方式加入到勝利牌區，選擇一位調查員來控制疊加的機關盒，然後推進。
cards.back_text:
If you advanced by defeating Nathan Wick:
You quickly pry the device from Nathan's hands and flee before you are noticed.
If you advanced by evading Nathan Wick:
You wait until Nathan is not looking, then sweep in and steal the device from the table next to him. You are long gone by the time he realizes it is missing.
If you advanced by parleying with Nathan Wick:
"All right, listen," Nathan explains quietly. "Truth is, there probably is a safer way for us to open the device. This building holds many secrets; more than you could possible know. But time is running thin, and Mr. Sanford wants it open by midnight. If you can open it before then, great. If not, well... If I were you, I wouldn't be around it when we try to force it open." He hands you the device and walks away, leaving you in silence.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果你通過擊敗南森·威克推進場景：
你迅速從南森的手中撬走儀器，趁著無人發覺，逃離現場。
如果你通過躲避南森·威克推進場景：
你趁著南森不注意，從他身旁的桌上偷走了儀器。當他意識到儀器不見了的時候，你早已離開。
如果你通過與南森·威克談判推進場景：
"好吧，聽著。"南森安靜地說道，"事實是，可能有另一種更安全的方法能打開儀器。這座建築有著許多秘密；遠比你能知道的要多。但是時間不多了，桑福德先生希望能在午夜之前把它打開。如果你能夠在那之前打開，當然再好不過。不然的話，那……要是我是你，等到我們要強行打開它的時候，我可不會待在它邊上。"他將儀器遞給你，然後靜靜地離開。

cards.name: The Four Keys
cards.text: Objective - If investigators at the same location control the Puzzle Box, the [skull] key, the [cultist] key, the [tablet] key, and the [elder_thing] key, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果同在一個地點的調查員控制了機關盒、[skull]鑰匙、[cultist]鑰匙、[tablet]和[elder_thing]鑰匙，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If the investigators are members of the Lodge, (→R1). - Otherwise, (→R2).
cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果調查員成為了秘社一員， (→結局1)。 - 否則，(→結局2)。

cards.name: Lodge Gates
cards.text: Enemies cannot spawn at the Lodge Gates. [action]: Resign. On second thought, maybe coming here was a bad idea.
cards.text_cn: 敵人不能生成在秘社大門。 [action]：撤退。再想一下，可能來這兒不是一個好主意。

cards.name: Lodge Gates
cards.text: Enemies cannot spawn at the Lodge Gates. [action]: Resign. On second thought, maybe coming here was a bad idea.
cards.text_cn: 敵人不能生成在秘社大門。 [action]：撤退。再想一下，可能來這兒不是一個好主意。

cards.name: Lobby
cards.back_text: The entrance to the Silver Twilight Lodge is guarded. You cannot enter the Lobby. Lodge Gates gains: "[action]: Parley. The guards recognize you from the Meiger estate and let you pass. Reveal the Lobby."
cards.back_text_cn: 銀暮秘社的入口有人把守。你不能進入前廳。 秘社大門獲得："[action]：談判。看門人在梅吉爾莊園見過你，於是讓你進門。翻開前廳。"

cards.name: Lobby
cards.text: Forced - After the Lobby is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在前廳被翻開後：隨機將放在一邊的1個鑰匙放在前廳上。

cards.name: Lodge Cellar
cards.text: Forced - After the Lodge Cellar is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在秘社地窖被翻開後：隨機將放在一邊的1個鑰匙放在秘社地窖上。

cards.name: Lodge Cellar
cards.back_text:
The rear entrance to the Silver Twilight Lodge is hidden. You cannot enter the Lodge Cellar.
Lodge Gates gains: "[action] Investigators at the Lodge Gates spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Reveal the Lodge Cellar."
cards.back_text_cn:
銀暮秘社的後門是隱藏起來的。你不能進入秘社地窖。
秘社大門獲得："[action]位於秘社大門的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：翻開秘社地窖。"

cards.name: Lounge
cards.text: Forced - After the Lounge is revealed: Put the set-aside Vault and Library locations into play. Put the set-aside August Lindquist asset into play in the Lounge. Place 1 random set-aside key on him.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在休息室被翻開後：將放在一邊的機密室和藏書室地點放置入場。將放在一邊的奧古斯特·林奎斯特支援放置入場，放在休息室。隨機將放在一邊的1個鑰匙放在他身上。

cards.name: Vault
cards.text: Forced - After the Vault is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在機密室被翻開後：隨機將放在一邊的1個鑰匙放在機密室上。
cards.back_text: The door to the Vault is locked. You cannot enter the Vault unless you control the [elder_thing] key.
cards.back_text_cn: 機密室的門鎖上了。你不能進入機密室，除非你控制[elder_thing]鑰匙。

cards.name: Library
cards.text: While you are investigating the Library, if you control the [tablet] key, the Library gets -3 shroud.
cards.text_cn: 你調查藏書室時，如果你控制[tablet]鑰匙，藏書室隱藏值-3。

cards.name: Lodge Catacombs
cards.text: Forced - When Lodge Catacombs is revealed: Put the set-aside Inner Sanctum and each of the set-aside Sanctum Doorway locations into play.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在秘社地下墓穴被翻開時：將放在一邊的聖堂內室和所有聖堂門廊地點放置入場。
cards.back_text: The door to the catacombs is locked. You cannot enter the Lodge Catacombs unless you control at least 1 ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key.
cards.back_text_cn: 地下墓穴的門鎖上了。你不能進入秘社地下墓穴，除非你控制至少1個([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])鑰匙。

cards.name: Ceremony Room
cards.text: Forced - When the round ends: Each investigator and each [[Ally]] asset in the Ceremony Room takes 1 direct horror. Cancel this effect if an investigator in the Ceremony Room controls the [skull] key.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在一輪結束時：在典禮室的每位調查員和每張[[盟友]]支援卡受到1點直接恐懼。如果在典禮室的調查員控制了[skull]鑰匙，取消本效果。

cards.name: Holding Cells
cards.text: Forced - After Holding Cells is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and spawn it in the Holding Cells. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在拘禁室被翻開後：查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出一張[[異教徒]]敵人，將其生成在拘禁室。混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Inner Sanctum
cards.text: Forced - After the Inner Sanctum is revealed: Place 1 random set-aside key on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在翻開聖堂內室後：隨機將放在一邊的1個鑰匙放在聖堂內室上。
cards.back_text: The door to the Inner Sanctum is locked. You cannot enter the Inner Sanctum unless you control the [cultist] key.
cards.back_text_cn: 聖堂內室的門鎖上了。你不能進入聖堂內室，除非你控制[cultist]鑰匙。

cards.name: Nathan Wick
cards.text: Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to persuade Nathan to let you find another option. If you succeed, place 1 resource on Nathan Wick. Then, if there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. If you fail, Nathan Wick attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 [action]：談判。說服南森再給你一次機會，檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，在南森·威克上放置1個資源。然後，如果他身上有1[per_investigator]個資源，將他加入勝利牌區。如果你失敗，南森·威克攻擊你。

cards.name: Lodge Jailor
cards.text: Spawn - Any [[Sanctum]] location. Aloof. Forced - After Lodge Jailor enters play: Place 2 doom and 1 random set-aside key on it. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, either remove 1 doom from Lodge Jailor, or take control of its key.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個[[聖堂]]地點。 冷漠。 強制 - 在秘社獄卒入場後：在其上放置2個毀滅標記和隨機1個放在一邊的鑰匙。 [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](3)。如果你成功，移除秘社獄卒上的1個毀滅標記或控制其鑰匙。

cards.name: Cell Keeper
cards.text: Spawn - Any [[Sanctum]] location. Alert. Forced - After Cell Keeper enters play: Place 2 doom and 1 random set-aside key on it. Forced - When you evade Cell Keeper by 2 or more: Take control of its key.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個[[聖堂]]地點。 警戒。 強制 - 在牢房看門人入場後：在其上放置2個毀滅標記和隨機1個放在一邊的鑰匙。 強制 - 在你躲避牢房看門人並超過難度至少2點時：控制其鑰匙。

cards.name: Summoned Beast
cards.text: Retaliate. Hunter. Summoned Beast gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror for every 2 doom in play. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase: Summoned Beast defeats each [[Humanoid]] enemy at its location. Move all doom from each of those enemies to Summoned Beast. Objective - If the Summoned Beast is defeated, (→R3).
cards.text_cn: 反擊。獵手。 場上每有2個毀滅標記，響應召喚的怪獸攻擊值+1，躲避值+1，造成+1傷害、+ 1恐懼。 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：響應召喚的怪獸擊敗在其地點的所有[[類人]]敵人。將被擊敗的敵人身上的所有毀滅標記移動到響應召喚的怪獸身上。 目標 - 如果本敵人被擊敗，(→結局3)。

cards.name: Knight of the Inner Circle
cards.text: Spawn - Any location connected to yours. Prey - Most ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) keys controlled. Alert. Aloof. Hunter. Forced - After you enter Knight of the Inner Circle's location (or vice-versa): Test [agility] (4). If you fail, Knight of the Inner Circle engages you.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個與你所在地點連接的地點。 獵物 - 控制最多([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])鑰匙的目標。 警戒。冷漠。獵手。 強制 - 在你進入核心圈騎士所在地點(或核心圈騎士進入你所在地點)後：檢定[agility](4)。如果你失敗，核心圈騎士與你交戰。

cards.name: Knight of the Outer Void
cards.text: Spawn - Any location connected to yours. Aloof. Peril. Retaliate. Revelation - After Knight of the Outer Void spawns, place either 1 or 2 doom on it. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (4). If you succeed, take control of 1 doom on Knight of the Outer Void, and flip it to its clue side. If you fail, Knight of the Outer Void attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個與你所在地點連接的地點。 冷漠。禍害。反擊。 顯現 - 在邊緣虛空騎士生成後，在其上放置1個或2個毀滅標記。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower]或[intellect](4)。如果你成功，控制邊緣虛空騎士上的1個毀滅標記，將其翻至線索面。如果你失敗，邊緣虛空騎士攻擊你。

cards.name: Call to Order
cards.text: Revelation - Find the 2 topmost [[Cultist]] enemies in the encounter discard pile and spawn them in the empty location with the most remaining clues. If no [[Cultist]] enemies are spawned by this effect, Call to Order gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 找出遭遇棄牌堆最頂上的2張[[異教徒]]敵人，將其生成在剩餘線索最多的無人地點。如果沒有[[異教徒]]敵人通過本效果生成，發號施令獲得湧動。

cards.name: Expulsion
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, Expulsion gains surge. Otherwise, the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack. Then, place each ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key you control on that enemy.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果沒有[[異教徒]]敵人在場，除籍獲得湧動。否則，最近的[[異教徒]]敵人準備並移動(每次移動1個地點)直到其到達你所在地點，與你交戰並立即攻擊你。然後，將你控制的所有([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])鑰匙放到該敵人身上。

cards.name: Beneath the Lodge
cards.text: If you control at least 1 ([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing]) key, Beneath the Lodge gains peril and its skill test gets +1 difficulty. Revelation - Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, you must either lose 1 clue or take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 如果你控制至少1個([skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing])鑰匙，秘社地底獲得禍害，並且其技能檢定難度+1。 顯現 - 檢定[intellect](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，必須失去1個線索或受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Mark of the Order
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - Check which investigator controls each key. The investigator with... - ...the [skull] key takes 1 damage. - ...the [cultist] key takes 1 horror. - ...the [tablet] key discards 2 random cards from hand. - ...the [elder_thing] key loses 3 resources.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 檢查控制每個鑰匙的調查員。如果調查員帶有…… - ……[skull]鑰匙，受到1點傷害。 - ……[cultist]鑰匙，受到1點恐懼。 - ……[tablet]鑰匙，隨機丟棄2張手牌。 - ……[elder_thing]鑰匙，失去3資源。

cards.name: August Lindquist
cards.text: [action] Investigators at August Lindquist's location spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Each investigator who spent at least 1 clue must either take 1 damage or 1 horror. Remove August Lindquist from the game and take control of his key.
cards.text_cn: [action]位於奧古斯特·林奎斯特所在地點的調查員以團隊為單位花費2[per_investigator]個線索：談判。每位花費了至少1個線索的調查員必須受到1點傷害或1點恐懼。將奧古斯特·林奎斯特移出遊戲，控制其鑰匙。

cards.name: Puzzle Box
cards.text: Forced - When you are defeated: Give control of the Puzzle Box to another investigator. [action]: Unlight a brazier at your location, exhaust The Spectral Watcher, or deal 5 damage to The Spectral Watcher if it is exhausted. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from The Spectral Watcher. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你被擊敗時：將機關盒交給另一位調查員控制。 [action]：熄滅你所在地點的火盆，消耗幽靈看守人，或對幽靈看守人造成5點傷害(如果其已被消耗)。這個行動不會引起幽靈看守人的趁亂攻擊(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Union and Disillusion
cards.text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -2. If this is a skill test during a circle action, reveal another token. [cultist]: -3. If you have no damage on you, take 1 damage. If you have no horror on you, take 1 horror. [tablet]: -3. If you fail, a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location attacks you (even if it is exhausted). [elder_thing]: -3. If this is a skill test during a circle action and you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：-2。如果該檢定是在陣法行動期間執行的，再抽一個標記。 [cultist]：-3。如果你身上沒有傷害標記，受到1點傷害。如果你身上沒有恐懼標記，受到1點恐懼。 [tablet]：-3。如果你失敗，你所在地點的一個[[幽靈]]敵人攻擊你(不論其是否處於消耗狀態)。 [elder_thing]：-3。如果該檢定是在陣法行動期間執行的且你檢定失敗，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。
cards.back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -3. If this is a skill test during a circle action, reveal another token. [cultist]: -4. If you have no damage on you, take 1 damage. If you have no horror on you, take 1 horror. [tablet]: -4. If you fail, a [[Spectral]] enemy at your location attacks you (even if it is exhausted). [elder_thing]: -4. If this is a skill test during a circle action and you fail, resolve each haunted ability on your location.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-3。如果該檢定是在陣法行動期間執行的，再抽一個標記。 [cultist]：-4。如果你身上沒有傷害標記，受到1點傷害。如果你身上沒有恐懼標記，受到1點恐懼。 [tablet]：-4。如果你失敗，你所在地點的一個[[幽靈]]敵人攻擊你(不論其是否處於消耗狀態)。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果該檢定是在陣法行動期間執行的且你檢定失敗，結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: THE LOVERS · VI
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If at least 1 character was "taken by the watcher," read the following:
Beyond the spectral mist, an awful scream resounds through the woods. It is distant, as though heard through a pane of glass, but distinct enough for you to know it is real.
For each character who was taken by the watcher, place 1 resource on The Spectral Watcher, as a stolen soul (even if The Spectral Watcher is currently out of play). Until the end of the scenario, The Spectral Watcher gains the following text: "For each stolen soul on The Spectral Watcher, it gets +1 fight and +1 [per_investigator] health." Keep this card next to the agenda deck as a reminder, and advance to agenda 2a.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
查看冒險日誌的"失蹤人口"區域。如果至少1個角色"被看守人抓走"，閱讀以下文本：
在鬼靈迷霧的另一頭，一聲恐怖的尖叫在樹林裡迴響。那聲音很遙遠，像是隔著一面玻璃傳來的，但又是那麼的清晰，令你知道這聲音是真實存在的。
每有一個角色被看守人抓走，在幽靈看守人身上放置1資源，作為1個被偷走的靈魂(不論幽靈看守人當時是否在場上)。 在本場冒險結束之前，幽靈看守人獲得以下文本："幽靈看守人上每有一個被偷走的靈魂，攻擊值+1，生命值+1[per_investigator]。"將本卡牌留在密謀牌堆旁邊以作提醒，然後推進至密謀2a。

cards.name: Crossroads of Fate
cards.back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R5)
cards.back_text_cn: 每位倖存的調查員被擊敗，並受到1點肉體創傷。 (→結局5)

cards.name: The Unvisited Isle
cards.back_text: Each investigator must randomly choose 1 of the set-aside Unvisited Isle locations, put it into play in front of him or her, and immediately move to that location (cannot be canceled). If the investigators sided with the coven, the brazier at each of those locations is already lit. Place a resource token on each of those locations to signify this. Shuffle each of the story cards beneath the scenario reference card and deal 1 at random to each investigator until all of them have been dealt. In player order, resolve each of the dealt story cards.
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員必須從放在一邊的未訪之島地點裡隨機選擇1張，將其放置入場，放到自己面前，並且立即移動到該地點(不能取消)。如果調查員支持女巫集會，所選的每個地點上的火盆已點燃。在所選的每個地點上放置一個資源標記以作表示。 將冒險輔助卡底下的每張劇情卡牌混洗，隨機給每位調查員發放1張，直到所有劇情卡牌發放完畢。按玩家順序，結算發放的每張劇情卡。

cards.name: Fated Souls
cards.text: Each investigator cannot leave the location in front of him or her.
cards.text_cn: 每位調查員不能離開自己面前的地點。

cards.back_text_cn: 將幽靈看守人生成在米斯卡塔尼克河。 將遭遇棄牌堆、放在一邊的所有看守人的攫噬和看守人的注視洗入遭遇牌堆。 將每位調查員面前的地點放回遊戲區域中央。(調查員不再受阻，可離開所在地點。) 將放在一邊的靈怪陷阱地點放置入場。如果調查員支持女巫集會，靈怪陷阱上的火盆已點燃。在其上方放置一個資源標記以作表示。

cards.text:
