cards.name: Gavriella's Fate
cards.text:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Gavriella disappeared into the mist and you are on Gavriella's trail:
Gavriella stumbles out of the mist, her eyes bloodshot and her voice strained. "Where am I?… Who are you?"
Take control of the set-aside Gavriella Mizrah story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Gavriella Mizrah's profile, record Gavriella is alive.
If Gavriella was claimed by specters: Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Gavriella's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.
Otherwise:
You find Gavriella's weapon lying in the grass, decayed and broken. No other sign of her can be seen.
cards.text_cn:
查看冒險日誌的"失蹤人口"區域。如果加弗瑞拉消失在迷霧之中並且調查員正在追查加弗瑞拉：
加弗瑞拉從霧中跌出，眼睛血紅，緊張地說："我在哪？……你是誰？"
控制放在一邊的加弗瑞拉·米茲拉克劇情支援卡。她不佔用盟友槽，直到本場冒險結束。在"失蹤人員"的加弗瑞拉·米茲拉克旁邊記錄加弗瑞拉還活著。
如果加弗瑞拉已被幽靈奪走性命： 將本卡牌翻回敵人面，將其生成在你所在地點。如果調查員正在追查加弗瑞拉，其生成時被消耗並且不處於交戰狀態。否則，其生成時與你交戰。
否則：
你發現加弗瑞拉的武器落在草叢裡，已經腐壞、破爛。而她本人不見蹤影。

cards.name: Jerome's Fate
cards.text:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Jerome disappeared into the mist and you are on Jerome's trail:
Jerome crawls out of the mist, and you help him to his feet. "Oh god… the mist…" he whispers. "It's all connected… It's all connected…"
Take control of the set-aside Jerome Davids story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot. Next to Jerome Davids's profile, record Jerome is alive.
If Jerome was claimed by specters: Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Jerome's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.
Otherwise:
You find a scrap of paper from Jerome's pocket notebook on the ground. It simply reads: "HELP"
cards.text_cn:
查看冒險日誌的"失蹤人口"區域。如果傑羅姆消失在迷霧之中並且調查員正在追查傑羅姆：
傑羅姆從霧中爬出，你扶著他起身。"我的天啊……那霧……"他低聲說道，"一切都有聯繫……一切都有聯繫……"
控制放在一邊的傑羅姆·戴維斯劇情支援卡。他不佔用盟友槽，直到本場冒險結束。在"失蹤人員"的傑羅姆·戴維斯旁邊記錄傑羅姆還活著。
如果傑羅姆已被幽靈奪走性命： 將本卡牌翻回敵人面，將其生成在你所在地點。如果調查員正在追查傑羅姆，其生成時被消耗並且不處於交戰狀態。否則，其生成時與你交戰。
否則：
你從地上找到了一張來自傑羅姆隨身筆記的紙片。上面只寫著兩個字："救命！"

cards.name: Penny's Fate
cards.text:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Penny disappeared into the mist and you are on Penny's trail:
Penny nearly runs directly into you. Her whole body shakes with panic as you hold her safe. "A-are you alive?" she cries. "Is this nightmare finally over?"
Take control of the set-aside Penny White story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, she does not take up an ally slot. Next to Penny White's profile, record Penny is alive.
If Penny was claimed by specters: Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Penny's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.
Otherwise:
You find Penny's apron lying on the ground, covered in blood. There is no other sign of her.
cards.text_cn:
查看冒險日誌的"失蹤人口"區域。如果佩妮消失在迷霧之中並且調查員正在追查佩妮：
佩妮險些把你撞了個滿懷。你護著她的時候，她全身都在顫抖。"你、你活著嗎？"她哭著說，"噩夢終於結束了嗎？"
控制放在一邊的佩妮·懷特劇情支援卡。她不佔用盟友槽，直到本場冒險結束。在"失蹤人員"的佩妮·懷特旁邊記錄佩妮還活著。
如果佩妮已被幽靈奪走性命： 將本卡牌翻回敵人面，將其生成在你所在地點。如果調查員正在追查佩妮，其生成時被消耗並且不處於交戰狀態。否則，其生成時與你交戰。
否則：
你在地上發現了佩妮的圍裙，被血液染紅，而她本人不見蹤影。

cards.name: Valentino's Fate
cards.text:
Check the "Missing Persons" section of the Campaign Log. If Valentino disappeared into the mist and you are on Valentino's trail:
Valentino limps out of the mist, leaning on a nearby tree. He chuckles morbidly as he spots you. "Cavalry's finally here, eh?"
Take control of the set-aside Valentino Rivas story asset. For the remainder of this scenario, he does not take up an ally slot. Next to Valentino Rivas's profile, record Valentino is alive.
If Valentino was claimed by specters: Flip this card to its enemy side and spawn it at your location. If you are on Valentino's trail, it spawns exhausted and unengaged. Otherwise, it spawns engaged with you.
Otherwise:
Valentino's cane lies in the mud, cracked nearly in half. Its handle is stained with old blood.
cards.text_cn:
查看冒險日誌的"失蹤人口"區域。如果瓦倫蒂諾消失在迷霧之中並且調查員正在追查瓦倫蒂諾：
瓦倫蒂諾一瘸一拐地走出迷霧，倚在附近一棵樹上。他發現你時，發出了病態的笑聲。"救兵終於來了，對嗎？"
控制放在一邊的瓦倫蒂諾·里瓦斯劇情支援卡。他不佔用盟友槽，直到本場冒險結束。在"失蹤人員"的瓦倫蒂諾·里瓦斯旁邊記錄瓦倫蒂諾還活著。
如果瓦倫蒂諾已被幽靈奪走性命： 將本卡牌翻回敵人面，將其生成在你所在地點。如果調查員正在追查瓦倫蒂諾，其生成時被消耗並且不處於交戰狀態。否則，其生成時與你交戰。
否則：
瓦倫蒂諾的手杖落在淤泥裡，幾乎斷成兩半。手杖把手沾著陳舊的血跡。

cards.name: Whippoorwill
cards.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Each investigator at Whippoorwill's location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility].
cards.text_cn:
冷漠。獵手。
位於夜鷹所在地點的調查員獲得-1[willpower]、-1[intellect]、-1[combat]和-1[agility]。

cards.name: Spectral Raven
cards.text: Prey - Lowest [intellect]. Alert. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - After Spectral Raven engages you: You must either resolve each haunted ability on your location, or Spectral Raven gets +2 fight and +2 evade until the end of the investigation phase.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 最低[intellect]的目標。 警戒。獵手。反擊。 強制 - 在幽靈烏鴉與你交戰後：你必須結算你所在地點的所有鬧鬼能力，或幽靈烏鴉獲得+2攻擊值和+2躲避值，直到調查階段結束。

cards.name: Eager for Death
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each damage on you. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。你身上每有1點傷害，本次技能檢定難度提升1點。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Psychopomp's Song
cards.text: Surge. Peril. Revelation - Add Psychopomp's Song to any investigator's threat area. Forced - When you would take 1 or more damage: Take 2 additional damage and discard Psychopomp's Song.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。禍害。 顯現 - 將靈魂之歌加入到任意一位調查員的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你將要受到至少1點傷害時：受到額外2點傷害，丟棄靈魂之歌。

cards.name: Death Approaches
cards.text: Surge. Peril. Revelation - Add Death Approaches to any investigator's threat area. Forced - When you would take 1 or more horror: Take 2 additional horror and discard Death Approaches.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。禍害。 顯現 - 將死期臨近加入到任意一位調查員的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你將要受到至少1點恐懼時：受到額外2點恐懼，丟棄死期臨近。

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). Increase this skill test's difficulty by 1 for each horror on you. If you fail, take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](2)。你身上每有1點恐懼，本次技能檢定難度提升1點。如果你失敗，受到2點傷害。

cards.name: Watcher's Gaze
cards.text: Revelation - Each investigator tests [willpower] (5). Each investigator who fails must resolve either the haunted ability on his or her location, or the haunted ability on The Spectral Watcher's location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 每位調查員檢定[willpower](5)。檢定失敗的每位調查員必須結算其所在地點的鬧鬼能力，或幽靈看守人所在地點的鬧鬼能力。

cards.name: In the Clutches of Chaos
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If there are fewer than 3 breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location.
[tablet]: -2. For each point you fail by, remove 1 breach from the current act.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, place 1 breach on a random location.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X為你所在地點的裂口和毀滅標記總數。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你所在地點的裂口少於3個，在其上放置1個裂口。
[tablet]：-2。你失敗且每低於難度1點，將當前場景的1個裂口移除。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你失敗，在隨機1個地點上放置1個裂口。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 higher than the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If there are fewer than 3 breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location.
[tablet]: -3. For each point you fail by, remove 1 breach from the current act.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 breach on a random location.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X為你所在地點的裂口和毀滅標記總數+1。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你所在地點的裂口少於3個，在其上放置1個裂口。
[tablet]：-3。你失敗且每低於難度1點，將當前場景的1個裂口移除。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你失敗，在隨機1個地點上放置1個裂口。

cards.name: THE CHARIOT · VII
cards.text: Forced - When doom would be placed on this agenda: Instead, place 1 breach on a number of different random locations equal to 1 more than the number of investigators. Forced - When a breach would be placed on a location with 3 breaches: Instead, resolve an incursion at that location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在毀滅標記將被放到本密謀上時：改為在數量等於調查員人數+1的隨機不同地點上放置1個裂口。 強制 - 在裂口標記將被放到帶有3個裂口的地點時：改為結算該地點的入侵一次。
cards.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If Anette Mason is possessed by evil, (→R3). - If Carl Sanford possesses the secrets of the universe, (→R4).
cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果安妮特·梅森被魔鬼附身，(→結局3)。 - 如果卡爾·桑福德知曉了宇宙之秘，(→結局4)。

cards.name: Dark Knowledge (v. I)
cards.text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance. When this act advances, move all of the breaches on it to the next act.
cards.text_cn: [free]移除本場景的3個裂口：在一個隨機地點上放置1個線索。 目標 - 在調查員集齊所需數量的線索時，必須立即花費線索並推進場景。在本場景推進時，將其上的所有裂口移動到下一張場景。

cards.name: Beyond the Grave
cards.text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - If Anette Mason is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: [free]移除本場景的3個裂口：在一個隨機地點上放置1個線索。 目標 - 如果安妮特·梅森被擊敗，推進場景。

cards.name: Dark Knowledge (v. II)
cards.text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - When the investigators have collected the requisite number of clues, they must immediately spend them and advance. When this act advances, move all of the breaches on it to the next act.
cards.text_cn: [free]移除本場景的3個裂口：在一個隨機地點上放置1個線索。 目標 - 在調查員集齊所需數量的線索時，必須立即花費線索並推進場景。在本場景推進時，將其上的所有裂口移動到下一張場景。

cards.name: New World Order
cards.text: [fast] Remove 3 breaches from this act: Place 1 clue on a random location. Objective - If Carl Sanford is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: [free]移除本場景的3個裂口：在一個隨機地點上放置1個線索。 目標 - 如果卡爾·桑福德被擊敗，推進場景。

cards.name: French Hill
cards.text: [action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Move 1 breach from French Hill to the current act, +1 additional breach for each [willpower] icon on that card.
cards.text_cn: [action]選擇並丟棄你一張手牌：將法蘭西山的1個裂口移動到當前場景，該手牌上每有1個[willpower]圖標，額外移動1個裂口到當前場景。

cards.name: French Hill
cards.text: [action]: Test [willpower] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from French Hill to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[willpower](2)。你成功且每超過難度1點，將法蘭西山的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: Rivertown
cards.text: [action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Move 1 breach from Rivertown to the current act, +1 additional breach for each [intellect] icon on that card.
cards.text_cn: [action]選擇並丟棄你一張手牌：將河岸城的1個裂口移動到當前場景，該手牌上每有1個[intellect]圖標，額外移動1個裂口到當前場景。

cards.name: Rivertown
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from Rivertown to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect](2)。你成功且每超過難度1點，將河岸城的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: Southside
cards.text: [fast]: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and move 1 breach from Southside to the current act. Choose a [[Power]] treachery discarded by this effect and resolve its revelation ability, if able.
cards.text_cn: [free]：丟棄遭遇牌堆頂的3張卡牌，將南區的1個裂口移動到當前場景。如果可能，選擇被此效果丟棄的一張[[力量]]詭計卡，結算其顯現能力。

cards.name: Southside
cards.text: [fast] Choose and discard any number of cards from your hand: For each card discarded in this way, move 1 breach from Southside to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [free]選擇並丟棄你任意數量的手牌：你每以此方式丟棄一張卡牌，將南區的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: Uptown
cards.text: [action] Choose and discard a card from your hand: Move 1 breach from Uptown to the current act, +1 additional breach for each [agility] icon on that card.
cards.text_cn: [action]選擇並丟棄你一張手牌：將住宅區的1個裂口移動到當前場景，該手牌上每有1個[agility]圖標，額外移動1個裂口到當前場景。

cards.name: Uptown
cards.text: [action]: Test [agility] (2). For each point you succeed by, move 1 breach from Uptown to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[agility](2)。你成功且每超過難度1點，將住宅區的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: South Church
cards.text: [action]: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.
cards.text_cn: [action]：抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。然後，將南區教堂的所有裂口移動到當前場景。 [action]：撤退。你趁著夜色隱蔽起來。

cards.name: South Church
cards.text: [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Move all breaches from South Church to the current act. [action]: Resign. You hide through the night.
cards.text_cn: [action]丟棄場上你控制的1張支援卡：將南區教堂的所有裂口移動到當前場景。 [action]：撤退。你趁著夜色隱蔽起來。

cards.name: Merchant District
cards.text: [action] Discard the top 5, 10, or 15 cards of your deck: For every 5 cards discarded in this way, move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act. Draw each weakness discarded in this way.
cards.text_cn: [action]丟棄你牌堆頂的5張、10張或15張卡牌：你每以此方式棄掉5張卡牌，將商人區的1個裂口移動到當前場景。抽取以此方式棄掉的所有弱點。

cards.name: Merchant District
cards.text: [fast] Spend 2 resources: Move 1 breach from Merchant District to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [free]花費2資源：將商人區的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: Hangman's Hill
cards.text: [action]: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Witch]] enemy and draw it. Then, move all breaches from Hangman's Hill to the current act. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: [action]：查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張[[女巫]]敵人。然後，將絞刑者山丘的所有裂口移動到當前場景。混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Silver Twilight Lodge
cards.text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move 1 breach from Silver Twilight Lodge to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [free]受到1點恐懼：將銀暮秘社的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: Hangman's Hill
cards.text: [fast] Take 1 damage: Move 1 breach from Hangman's Hill to the current act.
cards.text_cn: [free]受到1點傷害：將絞刑者山丘的1個裂口移動到當前場景。

cards.name: Silver Twilight Lodge
cards.text: [action]: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Silver Twilight]] enemy and draw it. Then, move all breaches from Silver Twilight Lodge to the current act. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: [action]：查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張[[銀暮秘社]]敵人。然後，將銀暮秘社的所有裂口移動到當前場景。混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Chaos Manifest
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). Place 1 breach on X different random locations, where X is the amount by which you failed.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。在X個不同的隨機地點上放置1個裂口，其中X是你失敗且低於檢定難度的點數。

cards.name: Primordial Gateway
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to a random location. Place breaches on attached location until there are exactly 3 breaches on it. Treat the attached location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]). [action]: Test [intellect] or [willpower] (4) to close the gateway. If you succeed, discard Primordial Gateway.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到隨機地點。在疊加的地點上放置裂口，直至該地點上有正好3個裂口。 將疊加的地點的文本框視為空白([[屬性]]除外)。 [action]：檢定[intellect]或[willpower](4)以關閉通道。如果你成功，丟棄元初通道。

cards.name: Terror Unleashed
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no breaches on your location, place 1 breach on your location. You must take X damage or horror, divided as you wish. X is the total amount of doom and breaches on your location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你所在地點沒有裂口，在其上放置1個裂口。你必須受到X點傷害或恐懼，由你自行分配，其中X是你所在地點的毀滅標記和裂口總數。

cards.name: Lodge Enforcer
cards.text: Spawn - Most breaches (or Silver Twilight Lodge if there are no locations in play with breaches on them). Retaliate. Treat Lodge Enforcer's location as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 裂口最多的地點(如果場上地點均無裂口，生成在銀暮秘社)。 反擊。 將秘社打手所在地點的文本框視作空白([[屬性]]除外)。

cards.name: Secrets of the Beyond
cards.text: Revelation - Find the [[Cultist]] enemy in play with the most doom on it. For each doom on that enemy, place 1 breach on that enemy's location. If no breaches are placed by this effect, Secrets of the Beyond gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 找出場上擁有最多毀滅標記的[[異教徒]]敵人。該敵人身上每有1個毀減標記，在其所在地點放置1個裂口。如果本效果未放置裂口，異界之秘獲得湧動。

cards.name: Witness of Chaos
cards.text: Spawn - Fewest breaches. Hunter. Forced - After Witness of Chaos enters a location: Place 1 breach on that location.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 裂口最少的地點。 獵手。 強制 - 在混沌見證者進入一個地點後：將1個裂口放在該地點上。

cards.name: Toil and Trouble
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Resolve the revelation ability on the topmost [[Power]] treachery in the encounter discard pile. - Resolve an incursion at your location.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)： - 結算遭遇棄牌堆最頂上的一張[[力量]]詭計卡上的顯現能力。 - 結算你所在地點的入侵一次。

cards.name: Before the Black Throne
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half of the doom on Azathoth (rounded up), to a minimum of 2.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, Azathoth attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -4. If your modified skill value for this test is 0, place 1 doom on Azathoth.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X是阿撒托斯上的一半毀滅標記數(向上取整)，至少為2。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你失敗，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出一張[[異教徒]]敵人並將其抽取。混洗遭遇牌堆。
[tablet]：-2。如果你失敗，阿撒托斯攻擊你。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你本次檢定的修正技能值為0，在阿撒托斯放置1個毀滅標記。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the amount of doom on Azathoth, to a minimum of 2.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, Azathoth attacks you.
[elder_thing]: -6. If your modified skill value for this test is 0, place 1 doom on Azathoth.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X是阿撒托斯上的毀滅標記數，至少為2。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你失敗，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出一張[[異教徒]]敵人並將其抽取。混洗遭遇牌堆。
[tablet]：-3。如果你失敗，阿撒托斯攻擊你。
[elder_thing]：-6。如果你本次檢定的修正技能值為0，在阿撒托斯放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE · X
cards.text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.
cards.text_cn:
每個地點與自己相鄰的地點相互連接。
在本密謀推進時，不要移除敵人的毀滅標記。
cards.back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it.
Endless walkways and steps of black stone are the only routes which guide you to your destination. It is an impossible maze to navigate.
Check Campaign Log. If Gilman's Journal is listed under "Mementos Discovered," you are able to find you way. Otherwise, you become hopelessly lost; each investigator must either move to the location to his or her left, or move the placement of his or her location once to the left (placing an empty space in the spot it previously occupied). A location cannot move more than once via this effect.
cards.back_text_cn:
所有[[異教徒]]敵人為儀式而自決。丟棄場上的所有[[異教徒]]敵人，並將他們身上的所有毀滅標記移動到阿撒托斯。 調查員隊長必須查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張魔鬼的笛聲。
通往你目的地的一路上全是無盡的步道和黑色石階。這是一個無法走出的迷宮。
查看冒險日誌。如果"遺留記憶"下方列有吉爾曼的日記，你可以找到出路。否則，你絕望地迷路了；每位調查員必須移動到其左方的地點，或將其地點向左移動一次(在其原來的位置放置一個虛空格子)。地點不能通過此效果移動超過一次。

cards.name: It Awaits
cards.text:
Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it.
Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances.
cards.text_cn:
每個地點與自己相鄰的地點相互連接。
在本密謀推進時，不要移除敵人的毀滅標記。
cards.back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it.
In this oblivion outside time, nothing is as it should be. The mist dances and churns around you. Laughter mocks you from beyond, and out from the dark nebulae emerges a familiar wraith, a being which should be long dead.
Check Campaign Log. If Worn Crucifix is listed under "Mementos Discovered," the wraith recognizes the crucifix you stole from Walter Gilman's room and backs away slowly, slinking into the darkness beyond. Otherwise, the wraith attacks you; each investigator must test [willpower] (4). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.back_text_cn:
所有[[異教徒]]敵人為儀式而自決。丟棄場上的所有[[異教徒]]敵人，並將他們身上的所有毀滅標記移動到阿撒托斯。 調查員隊長必須查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張魔鬼的笛聲。
在這超越時間之外的遺忘之地，一切都不復原樣。雲霧在你周圍飛舞翻騰。遠處傳來的笑聲嘲笑著你，黑色星雲裡出現了一道熟悉的鬼魂——一個早已死去的人。
查看冒險日誌。如果"遺留記憶"下方列有磨損的十字架，鬼魂認得你從沃爾特·吉爾曼房間偷來的十字架，緩緩後退，遁入彼端的黑暗之中。 否則，鬼魂攻擊你；每位調查員必須檢定[willpower](4)。檢定失敗的每位調查員受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。

cards.name: The Final Countdown
cards.text: Each location is connected to each location adjacent to it. Do not remove doom from enemies when this agenda advances. (Beware - the scenario will not end when this agenda advances, but the doom of the world will be close at hand.)
cards.text_cn: 每個地點與自己相鄰的地點相互連接。 在本密謀推進時，不要移除敵人的毀滅標記。 (注意——本密謀推進時，本場冒險不會結束，但世界末日即將到來。)
cards.back_text:
Each [[Cultist]] enemy commits ritual suicide. Discard each [[Cultist]] enemy in play and move all doom from them to Azathoth. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for a copy of Daemonic Piping and draw it. There is no longer an agenda deck, but the scenario is not over. Until the end of the scenario, doom that would be placed on the current agenda is instead placed on Azathoth, and all doom in play is considered to be on Azathoth.
You come across another circle of Azathoth's worshippers, led by a hooded, shapeless form which holds an ancient lantern high above its head. The lantern's dim grey light scarcely pierces the realm's darkness. Somehow, the phantom is familiar to you; some vague sense of kinship drives you onward.
Check Campaign Log. If Corn Husk Doll is listed under "Mementos Discovered," the creature recognizes you, as well. It peers at you curiously, and the circle of prayer is silenced; remove 1 doom from Azathoth. Otherwise, the creature barely notices you, and the circle resumes its chanting.
cards.back_text_cn:
所有[[異教徒]]敵人為儀式而自決。丟棄場上的所有[[異教徒]]敵人，並將他們身上的所有毀滅標記移動到阿撒托斯。 調查員隊長必須查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張魔鬼的笛聲。 密謀牌堆不復存在，但本場冒險沒有結束。將被放到當前密謀的毀滅標記，改為放到阿撒托斯上，場上所有毀滅標記視為在阿撒托斯上，直到本場冒險結束。
你遇到另一夥阿撒托斯的崇拜者，一個無形的兜帽者帶領著他們，將一盞古老的提燈高舉過頭。提燈黯淡的灰色光芒根本無法照亮這個國度的黑暗。不知為何，你覺得那幽靈很是熟悉；某種說不清的親切感驅使著你前進。
查看冒險日誌。如果"遺留記憶"下方列有玉米皮娃娃，那幽靈也認出了你。它好奇地盯著你看，周圍一圈信徒停止了祈禱；移除阿撒托斯的1個毀滅標記。否則，那幽靈幾乎沒有注意到你，周圍一圈祈禱者繼續詠唱。

cards.name: The Cosmos Beckons
cards.text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - Only investigators at Hideous Palace may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)
cards.text_cn: [action]花費X個線索：抽取"宇宙"頂上的X張卡牌。選擇其中一張卡牌，按照其"宇宙 -"指示放置入場，移動到其上。將其餘卡牌洗回"宇宙"。 目標 - 只有位於憎惡宮殿的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。(注意：不位於此處的所有調查員將會陣亡。)
cards.back_text:
Remove Cosmic Ingress from the game. Shuffle each empty space into its owner's deck and each location in play other than Hideous Palace into the Cosmos. Each investigator at those locations is left behind and is killed. Each enemy at those locations is shuffled into the top 5 cards of the encounter deck.
Take the set-aside Court of the Great Old Ones and the top 2 cards of the Cosmos, and shuffle them so you cannot tell which is which. Then, put them into play along with empty space, as depicted in "Location Placement for Act 2" in the Campaign Guide.
In player order, each investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將宇宙入口移出遊戲。將場上所有虛空格子的卡牌洗入所有者牌庫，將場上除憎惡宮殿以外的所有地點洗入"宇宙"。(FAQ, v1.7)位於這些地點的所有調查員被拋棄，陣亡。將這些地點的所有敵人與遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌堆頂。 拿取放在一邊的舊日支配者皇廷和"宇宙"頂上的2張卡牌，將其混洗至無法分辨。然後，將這3張卡牌與虛空格子一同放置入場，如劇本手冊的"場景2參考擺放位置"所示。 按照玩家順序，每位調查員依次抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。

cards.name: In Azathoth's Domain
cards.text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - Only investigators at Court of the Great Old Ones may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (Beware - any investigator who is not there will be killed.)
cards.text_cn: [action]花費X個線索：抽取"宇宙"頂上的X張卡牌。選擇其中一張卡牌，按照其"宇宙 -"指示放置入場，移動到其上。將其餘卡牌洗回"宇宙"。 目標 - 只有位於舊日支配者皇廷的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。(注意：不位於此處的所有調查員將會陣亡。)
cards.back_text:
Remove Hideous Palace from the game. Shuffle each empty space into its owner's deck and each location in play other than Court of the Great Old Ones into the Cosmos. Each investigator at those locations is left behind and is killed. Each enemy at those locations is shuffled into the top 5 cards of the encounter deck.
Take the set-aside The Black Throne and the top 3 cards of the Cosmos, and shuffle them so you cannot tell which is which. Then, put them into play along with empty space, as depicted in "Location Placement for Act 3" in the Campaign Guide.
In player order, each investigator draws the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將憎惡宮殿移出遊戲。將場上所有虛空格子的卡牌洗入所有者牌庫，將場上除舊日支配者皇廷以外的所有地點洗入"宇宙"。(FAQ, v1.7)位於這些地點的所有調查員被拋棄，陣亡。將這些地點的所有敵人與遭遇牌堆頂的5張卡牌一同混洗，放到遭遇牌堆頂。 拿取放在一邊的黑色王座和"宇宙"頂上的3張卡牌，將其混洗至無法分辨。然後，將這4張卡牌與虛空格子一同放置入場，如劇本手冊的"場景3參考擺放位置"所示。 按照玩家順序，每位調查員依次抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。

cards.name: What Must Be Done
cards.text: [action] Spend X clues: Draw the top X cards of the Cosmos. Choose one to put into play using its "Cosmos -" instructions, and move to it. Shuffle the rest back into the Cosmos. Objective - If the lead investigator is at The Black Throne and there are no clues on it, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費X個線索：抽取"宇宙"頂上的X張卡牌。選擇其中一張卡牌，按照其"宇宙 -"指示放置入場，移動到其上。將其餘卡牌洗回"宇宙"。 目標 - 如果調查員隊長位於黑色王座，且該地點上沒有線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If at least two of the following are true, you may proceed to (→R2): You accepted your fate, Mesmirizing Flute is listed under "Mementos Discovered," and Ritual Components is listed under "Mementos Discovered." - If at least two of the following are true, you may proceed to (→R3): You rejected your fate, Scrap of Torn Shadow is listed under "Mementos Discovered," and Wisp of Spectral Mist is listed under "Mementos Discovered." - Otherwise, (→R4).
cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果達成下方至少2種情況，你可以前往(→結局2)：你接受了自己的命運、"遺留記憶"下方列有催眠長笛、"遺留記憶"下方列有儀式道具。 - 如果達成下方至少2種情況，你可以前往(→結局3)：你拒絕了自己的命運、"遺留記憶"下方列有殘影碎片、"遺留記憶"下方列有鬼魂迷霧。" - 否則，(→結局4)。

cards.name: Cosmic Ingress
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Add clues to Cosmic Ingress until it has 3 clues on it. Each [[Void]] location gains: "[action]: Shuffle this location into the Cosmos, moving each investigator and enemy that was at this location to Cosmic Ingress."
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當一輪結束時：在宇宙入口上增加線索，直到其上有3個線索。 所有[[虛空]]地點獲得："[action]：將本地點洗入‘宇宙’，將位於本地點的所有調查員和敵人移動到宇宙入口。"

cards.name: Hideous Palace
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Add clues to Hideous Palace until it has 4 clues on it. Each [[Void]] location gains: "[action]: Shuffle this location into the Cosmos, moving each investigator and enemy that was at this location to Hideous Palace."
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當一輪結束時：在憎惡宮殿上增加線索，直到其上有4個線索。 所有[[虛空]]地點獲得："[action]：將本地點洗入‘宇宙’，將位於本地點的所有調查員和敵人移動到憎惡宮殿。"

cards.name: Court of the Great Old Ones
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the round: Add clues to Court of the Great Old Ones until it has 6 clues on it. Each [[Void]] location gains: "[action]: Shuffle this location into the Cosmos, moving each investigator and enemy that was at this location to Court of the Great Old Ones."
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當一輪結束時：在舊日支配者皇廷上增加線索，直到其上有6個線索。 所有[[虛空]]地點獲得："[action]：將本地點洗入‘宇宙’，將位於本地點的所有調查員和敵人移動到舊日支配者皇廷。"

cards.name: The Black Throne
cards.text: The Black Throne gets +X shroud, where X is half of the doom on Azathoth (rounded up). Haunted - You must either place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 黑色王座隱藏值+ X，其中X是阿撒托斯上的一半毀滅標記數(向上取整)。 鬧鬼 - 你必須在阿撒托斯上面放置1個毀滅標記，或者阿撒托斯攻擊你。

cards.name: Dancer's Mist
cards.text: Cosmos - You must either connect to the right, or lose 2 resources and connect to an adjacent location in a direction of your choice. [reaction] After you move to Dancer's Mist, remove 1 resource from the scenario reference card: Move to a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 宇宙 - 本卡牌必須：與右方連接；或者失去2資源，與你一個相鄰地點的任意方向連接。 [reaction]在你移動到舞者之霧後，移除冒險輔助卡的1資源：移動到一個連接地點。

cards.name: Flight into Oblivion
cards.text: Cosmos - You must either connect above, or take 2 horror and connect to the topmost revealed location in a direction of your choice. [action] Remove 1 resource from the scenario reference card: Move the placement of Flight into Oblivion once upward, placing an empty space in the spot it previously occupied. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: 宇宙 - 本卡牌必須：與上方連接；或者受到2點恐懼，與其同列位置最靠上的已揭示地點的任意方向連接。 [action]移除冒險輔助卡的1資源：將飛入湮滅向上移動一次，在其原來所在位置放置一個虛空格子。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Infinity of Darkness
cards.text: Cosmos - You must either connect below, or take 2 damage and connect to the bottommost revealed location in a direction of your choice. [action] Remove 1 resource from the scenario reference card: Move the placement of Infinity of Darkness once downward, placing an empty space in the spot it previously occupied. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: 宇宙 - 本卡牌必須：與下方連接；或者受到2點傷害，與其同列位置最靠下的已揭示地點的任意方向連接。 [action]移除冒險輔助卡的1資源：將無盡黑暗向下移動一次，在其原來所在位置放置一個虛空格子。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次。)

cards.name: Cosmic Gate
cards.text: Cosmos - Connect to any revealed location, in a direction of your choice. Forced - After you enter Cosmic Gate: You must either spend 1 clue or take 1 horror. [action] Remove 1 resource from the scenario reference card: Move any number of investigators at Cosmic Gate to any other [[Void]] location.
cards.text_cn: 宇宙 - 與任意一個已揭示地點的任意方向連接。 強制 - 在你進入宇宙門扉後：你必須花費1個線索或受到1點恐懼。 [action]移除冒險輔助卡的1資源：將位於宇宙門扉的任意數量的調查員移動到任意一個其他的[[虛空]]地點。

cards.name: Pathway into Void
cards.text: Cosmos - Connect in a direction of your choice. Forced - After you enter Pathway into Void: You must either discard 1 card from your hand or take 1 damage. [action] Remove 1 resource from the scenario reference card: Move Pathway into Void to any adjacent spot, placing an empty space in the spot it previously occupied. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 宇宙 - 與任意方向連接。 強制 - 在你進入虛空之路後：你必須丟棄1張手牌，或受到1點傷害。 [action]移除冒險輔助卡的1資源：將虛空之路移動到任意一個相鄰的位置，在其原來所在位置放置一個虛空格子。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Mindless Dancer
cards.text: Spawn - Farthest empty space. Hunter. Mindless Dancer can enter empty space as if it were a location. Forced - After Mindless Dancer moves to an empty space via its hunter keyword: Resolve its hunter keyword again. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 距離最遠的虛空格子。 獵手。 盲目舞者可以進入虛空格子，將其視為進入一個地點。 強制 - 在盲目舞者通過其獵手關鍵詞移動到一個虛空格子後：再次結算其獵手關鍵詞。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Ultimate Chaos
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, attach Ultimate Chaos to Azathoth. If you fail by 2 or more, take 1 damage and 1 horror. If you fail by 3 or more, Ultimate Chaos gains surge. Cannot be canceled. If there are 3 copies of Ultimate Chaos attached to Azathoth, discard them and either place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks each investigator in player order. Cannot be canceled.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)。如果你失敗，將究極混沌疊加到阿撒托斯。如果你失敗且低於難度至少2點，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼. 如果你失敗且低於難度至少3點，究極混沌獲得湧動。不能被取消。 如果阿撒托斯上疊加了3張究極混沌，將這3張卡牌丟棄，在阿撒托斯上放置1個毀滅標記，或者阿撒托斯按玩家順序攻擊每位調查員。不能被取消。

cards.name: Whispered Bargain
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): Place 1 doom on Azathoth, or Azathoth attacks you.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)：在阿撒托斯上放置1個毀滅標記，或阿撒托斯攻擊你。

cards.name: The End is Nigh!
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (1). This test gets +X difficulty, where X is the current agenda number. If there is no agenda in play, X is 4. If you fail, move each doom on each [[Cultist]] enemy in play to Azathoth (or place 1 doom on Azathoth if there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](1)。本次檢定難度+X，其中X是當前密謀編號。如果場上已經沒有密謀，X為4。如果你失敗，將場上每個[[異教徒]]敵人的所有毀滅標記移動到阿撒托斯上(如果場上沒有[[異教徒]]敵人，則將1個毀滅標記放在阿撒托斯上)。

cards.name: A World in Darkness
cards.text: Revelation - If there is no doom on Azathoth, A World in Darkness gains surge. Otherwise, for each doom on Azathoth, you must choose one: - Lose 1 resource. - Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. - Take 1 horror. - Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果阿撒托斯上沒有毀滅標記，黑暗世界獲得湧動。否則，阿撒托斯每有1個毀滅標記，你必須選擇以下一項： - 失去1資源。 - 選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。 - 受到1點恐懼。 - 受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Azathoth
cards.text: Azathoth is oblivious and omnipotent. It is immune to all player card effects and investigator actions, and cannot be defeated by any means. Forced - If there is 10 or more doom on Azathoth: The Blind Idiot God rises from its throne in the ultimate void of chaos and devours the universe. (→R1)
cards.text_cn: 阿撒托斯懵懂不察而又無所不能。其免疫所有玩家的卡牌效果和調查員行動，並且不能被任何方式擊敗。 強制 - 如果阿撒托斯上有至少10個毀滅標記：盲目愚癡之神從它究級混沌虛空的王座升起，吞食宇宙。(→結局1)
